notes.title: Flipper’s New Sparkle! ✨ Sign up for free HF Remaster playtests!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Flippers![/h1][p][/p][p]We’ve decided to update you on some things that happened lately with the [b]House Flipper Remastered Collection[/b], and trust me when I say we’ve been busy![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/d816178dd93ae6e1c579aab9f2c7d2f69f06faeb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That’s right! We’re in the middle of a total texture and model upgrade for House Flipper! You must admit that it shines better than a new car! Just like with the car, you can expect every object in the game to be better, sharper and [i]shinier than ever! [/i]✨
[/p][p]Speaking of Love we have plenty of new items ready for showcase from the new addition to the [b]Remastered Collection[/b]. We made sure that the new items match the original [b]House Flipper [/b]vibe but have the flair of the remastered.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/ac0135de768805be5db3acd9c3fcc84f8e24b6c9.png"][/img][/p][p]We wanted to make some new additions to the mechanics added in [b]Dine Out [/b]so with the new content you might expect some more tableware![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/6ffcc7b8b981133d9abe90ef8625b6ac5f379c7c.png"][/img][/p][p]Alright, we know that all of that red can be overwhelming. We’ve got something for you rustic people. I know some of you will find a way to introduce the new furniture into your designs![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/497ac8373210b5d323442b88993e42f4b4367080.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Over the years, our DLCs introduced a wide range of new material variants, from sleek woods to modern finishes. Now, with the upcoming Remaster, we’re giving that same special treatment to all the classic furniture from the base game! We’re significantly expanding the number of variants and adding more item tags, making it easier than ever to bring your unique design vision to life![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/6a965588662a9fb2f6b88d49a74692a3786654cc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You might remember that we’ve mentioned that the story or at least the characters will be reimagined from the base game. Please prepare a round of applause for your clients![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/4bf59e4c4103b566b2d8bb5192c9f56ca1f7940f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Aside from the reimagined characters we have something new. We wanted to add a bit of ✨[i]”Wow effects"✨[/i] to the jobs to make them just a tiny bit more memorable![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/ce149b11b0819f1bd82b7aabbd874b183372693c.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Yes, every single Job will receive its own logo![/i][/p][p][i]
[/i]Let me remind you that we[b] [/b]don't have a final price for House Flipper Remastered Collection yet, but there will definitely be a [b]discount depending on the amount of DLCs you have[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🏯 TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025![/h3][p]Hey Flippers! If you're heading to Japan, we'd love to see you at our booth! Stop by to say hi, give us a high-five, and chat about all things House Flipper.[/p][p]Even better, you can be among the first in the world to play the [b]public demo of the House Flipper Remastered Collection[/b]! 🎮[/p][p]And for everyone else, stay tuned! We're also bringing some exciting news for House Flipper 2 players straight from Japan![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/c41e1c9e1f7def8f39c5eed6579c492bf45028fd.png"][/img][/p][p]HALL AND STAND NUMBER: [b]General Exhibition Area, 06-C02[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]✨ Sign up for free playtests![/h3][p]it's incredibly important to us that you get to experience the Remaster firsthand. To make that happen, we're excited to invite you to sign up for our upcoming playtests![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/d6976e76819432dda93f0ee1fa72c6f16479951e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're targeting a [b]November[/b] release for playtest access, and we'll announce the specific date as soon as it's locked in. This exclusive test will feature a completely refreshed version of a classic job from the base game, plus an entirely new mission for you to tackle![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710840/House_Flipper_Remastered_Collection/"][/dynamiclink]We can't wait to hear what you think. Are you looking forward to it?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🍂 The leaves are falling, and so are the prices! 🍂[/h3][p]The Pre-Autumn Sale is ON! 🍁 Grab House Flipper for a massive 80% OFF now, with huge discounts on all DLCs![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15013/The_Flipper_Bundle/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47779/House_Flipper__Dine_Out_Bundle/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31350/Everybody_Loves_Animals/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Class is in session! 🎓 [b]Campus Life[/b] has officially launched. To celebrate, we're offering an [b]extra 30%[/b] off the bundle with House Flipper! Grab your student ID and your hammer with this amazing deal![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103090/Campus_Life/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58801/House_Flipper_x_Campus_Life/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][h3]⋆⭒˚𖠋𖠋𖠋*.⋆ Join Our Discord![/h3][p]Come hang out and chat about all our games. Whether you're a fan of the original [b]House Flipper[/b], the [b]House Flipper Remastered Collection[/b], the newly released [b]Campus Life[/b], or any of our other titles, we'd love to have you! Don't miss out. Join us on [url="https://discord.com/invite/frozenwayofficial"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/c08f988e2f8fce7af9e0dbfcd7b9f11d58f39393.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]See you soon and happy flipping![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p][p]~ Frozen Way Team[/p][p][/p]

[/h2][h3]Jetpacks, spy glasses packed with tech, robots disguised as attaché cases, hologram projectors, laser-shooting watches! 🕵️‍♂️
[/h3][p]In Quartermaster, you’ll design, build, and optimize your agency’s layout to serve incoming spy agents as efficiently as possible. Manage your team of quartermasters to research and develop new gadgets that help expand your services. Keep your Officers, Coordinators, and other staff in top shape by addressing their needs, improving workflows, and making necessary adjustments to hiring and firing as needed. Presentation matters too, so don’t forget to impress your clients while keeping a watchful eye on internal security. Double agents might be lurking, ready to sabotage your operation from within. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3657070/Quartermaster/"][/dynamiclink]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/2174542b573557f5088063f3ff9f42f2a7d6e96e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Some words from CherryPick Games! 🍒
[/h3][p]Quartermaster began as a passion project. As fans of the building sim genre, we at Cherrypick Games were eager to return to our roots, drawing on our past work on titles like My Hospital and My Spa Resort. When the idea came to combine base building with spies, gadgets, and undercover operations, we were all in. And teaming up with the amazing crew at Frozen District has only made the journey more exciting.[/p][p]We’re a small but passionate team of ten, driven by our love for games, pop culture, and game development. Our motto is quality first, and we’re putting our full hearts into making Quartermaster something truly special 🖤[/p][p][/p][p]You can join the game [url="https://discord.gg/uC44H7KwnK"]Discord[/url] here!

[i]~Kiki ❤[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🐳 Let's celebrate World Ocean Day 2025!
notes.content:
[h3]🌊 The ocean is our planet’s life support![/h3][hr][/hr]
Today, together with [b][url=https://games.whales.org/]Games For Waves[/url][/b] we're celebrating [b][url=https://games.whales.org/world-ocean-day-festival-2025/]World Ocean Day 2025[/url][/b]!

Super glad to be part of this year's World Ocean Day Steam Sale, alongside other incredible game developers who decided to support the cause!
From June 5–12, you'll find House Flipper and all of its DLCs on discounts up to 75%, and a part of the profit goes directly to [b][url=https://uk.whales.org/]Whale and Dolphin Conservation (WDC)[/url][/b]!


"[i]WDC’s World Ocean Day Steam Sale has grown into a significant event in the gaming calendar, so far raising more than £840,000 in critical funds to protect whales, dolphins, and the oceans.

2024's event raised an incredible total of £122,000 towards WDC's global conservation work, including fully funding a vital project in Sri Lanka, engaging with fishing communities to alter their fishing methods to be less harmful to marine life, while still enabling them to earn a living from the sea.[/i]"


Keep in mind, that the Steam Sale is just one part of the whole event! Content creators from all around the globe do their best to support the cause as well, by being a part of the [b][url=twitch.tv/gamesforwaves]#ForTheOcean Streaming Festival[/url][/b]!

If you'd like to tune in, and check out all the details, head over to
https://games.whales.org/world-ocean-day-festival-2025/

If you'd like to help out directly by donating, you can do that here:

notes.title: 🍋 Discounts, updates and fresh lemonade? 👀
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Flippers![/h1]

As the saying goes “New year, Old us”! We hope the end of your year was just as festive as ours! With all the celebratory vibes, we’re still not slowing down and have some [b]fresh updates for you![/b]

[h3]Lemonade stand and some smaller fixes in the new update for the Dine Out DLC[/h3]
In this update, we’re adding a refreshing new feature – [b]a lemonade stand![/b] Perfect for your outdoor spaces, it’s a charming addition that will help bring your restaurants to life.
Along with the stand, we've introduced a [b]number of minor fixes[/b] and[b] quality-of-life improvements [/b]based on your feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/e96a960e0cf74646e64c0d60509ffac48a47ab69.gif[/img]

[h3]But that’s not all we’ve prepared for you…[/h3]

If you haven’t played our latest restaurant-themed expansion yet, now’s the perfect time. You can grab it with a 20% discount. The promotion is live now and will last until the 3rd of February, 7:00 PM CET.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2819590/House_Flipper__Dine_Out_DLC

We’re always reading the comments that our wonderful Community is leaving us. We always appreciate the time and effort you give to let us know your feedback and the way you engage with our games. One particular Steam Review caught our eyes…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1b18a9b66985589d659cb01f4900a3ad37c19d87.png[/img]

[i]“super addition but how about adding stage spotlights with the options for mounting on the wall and on the ceiling would be great. Currently the addition introduces stage spotlights that can be placed on the floor. :)” - Translated into English[/i]

Based on that and on the gathered feedback we’ve got from all of our Community We’re [b]adding a few more items for the Party Furniture Pack[/b]! Now you can enjoy a spotlight lamp and two pole dance poles![i]~Enjoy![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/97096be0da2b260fd5fbee037c531efe77a7eaa2.png[/img]

The 26th is right around the corner, and I hope you’re all ready for the release of [b]Dine Out DLC[/b]! We all know how it feels to wait for a DLC to a game we like, and with that in mind, we’ve decided to give you the last bit of insight into the DLC!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Order up! 🧾[/h3]

Let’s start where every restaurant meal starts… Right at the table with our guests!
Enjoy your surroundings and choose something tasty from the menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/6901cd031421dac172b0d42fcb5692692a62a1d1.png[/img]
[i]Are we thinking of some fancy dinner here? [/i]

Is the fancy interior not to your liking? My esteemed guests, we can arrange a different table for you. Maybe this cosy little cafe will be more to your liking?

[i]I’ll take a latte and a… Cream puff![/i]

[i]We have a big order coming! Prepare your workstations and pots![/i]

[b]Let’s slow down with this restaurant talk for now… [/b]
As you all know, House Flipper is and always will be a game about renovations. [b]Dine Out[/b] is just another stop in your Flipping journey; you should look at it that way. We’ve prepared a lot of new furniture for you to recreate or design your kitchens, restaurants and other buildings in the game. We created tools for your imagination, and just in a bit, you’ll be able to use them in your creations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/a3151df3debf457054e12d4180399c9d47ccdce2.png[/img]
[i]The kitchen’s all ready and waiting for you![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/f2d1f9ee413cf29149b54d84dc2f818801d41d65.gif[/img]

[h3]Time to set up the table! 🍽️[/h3]

As the title says, with everything ready, we can finally set up that table by the river. Enjoy the scenery with that little gallery!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/8940fb7857d04806b5d4f1c3f6d9f51acc2dba6c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/aed48324839ef71f7286fba6c26c8fed28b6f39d.jpg[/img]

And with that, we’ve arrived nearly at the end of this devlog. In almost two weeks, you’ll be able to create similar creations with Dine Out DLC, amongst other new features introduced in the DLC.

But before we close it all off, here’s a sneak peek at an item we’re adding with the new content… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1e55b587377d183cea5d30dd6f6e077be9572026.gif[/img]

Thank you for sticking with us until the very end! We would like to invite you to our discord personally. We’re always looking forward to hearing your feedback! And if you haven’t already be sure to add Dine Out DLC to your Wishlist!

notes.title: 🥩 Dine Out DLC Devlog + Historical Museum Update! 🦕
notes.content:
Hello, Flippers!

Welcome to the latest Dine Out DLC development update, freshly crafted just for you. Settle in and get ready for a feast of exciting new features and updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2819590/House_Flipper__Dine_Out_DLC/

[hr][/hr]
[h3]BUT FIRST! 🤩[/h3]

We have a little surprise for you! [b]The completely free Historical Museum Update for House Flipper is now available! Inside, you'll find not only a new house but also over 35 new objects inspired by history![/b] The update also brings several minor optimizations to improve the game's performance. We are constantly working to provide you with the best gaming experience possible. Thank you for being with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/2a6458cb4a5d8e13699a335c5ba9451fd866a8b8.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]It’s time to lay out the fancy stuff…[/h3]

Regarding the Dine Out DLC, we've been busy lately, crafting new content for you. First up, we're introducing fresh mechanics specifically designed for this DLC. Next, we have a useful addition to the Universal Cooker to enhance your kitchen projects. Plus, there's a sneak peek at some of the new houses you'll be able to renovate. And at the end, we've gathered a variety of items to inspire and expand your decorating ideas. We're excited to share this Devlog with you.

Let’s talk a bit about the new mechanic we’re rolling out in the Dine Out DLC.
Table cloths are an important part of every fancy restaurant. With that in mind we’re developing a tool that will give you a way to add this type of decoration to most of the tables in the game!
It’s time to cut some cloth! Length of every tablecloth can be adjusted at the moment of placement!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/935350b59f3ff429b9bd128dcca331cdd174ca73.gif[/img]
[i]Let’s try not to leave any stains [/i]

With the table ready to be served, your freshly renovated restaurant is the talk of the town! Now, get ready for a delicious twist in House Flipper! 
Remember the Universal Cooker we introduced earlier? You'll now have access to a new addition – the Cookbook, where all your recipes will be automatically saved. Kick things off with a few starters to create amazing dishes that add a unique flair to your renovated eateries. Unlock even more culinary creations as you progress with flipping!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1ddc213cf025a593ec218122b6e960f9756c4c80.png[/img][i]Honestly, I’m down for some Bibimbap[/i] 😋

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Let’s go back to the basics for a moment…[/h3]

We can’t forget that House Flipper is still a game about flipping. We’ve heard your voices and we want to assure you that the new DLC doesn’t change the whole main aspect of the game. To back our words we’ve decided to show you some spots in need of flipping. 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/cbaa00fd07b65cb3fee717d3c362a974f6a63d7d.png[/img][i]Maybe we could somehow use those pool tables…[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/493650632db622a4ee01e344fa6a26577e631a8f.png[/img][i]Is that a Frozen District t-shirt?![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/ebce189b5898e9efcdbac50c1cb2a7faf936491e.png[/img][i]If we get rid of those crates it’ll be sooo spacious![/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Let there be light! 💡[/h3]

In a previous Devlog, we’ve told you about the new Neons that are coming along with Dine Out. Today it’s time to show you one more thing we’re working on regarding them. We wanted to give you a mechanic that’ll allow you to create your own Neon Writings!

Shine in the spotlight thanks to the Neon customisation mechanic! Wake up your inner artist and adjust them accordingly to your taste. You can create your personalized text, change its size, adjust light intensity, choose your favorite font, and more.

We're all ears for your opinion so let us know - will you add neon to your renovated restaurant? Do you like the vibe? We're waiting in the comments section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1d761e4cea9d6a2e54a65bf7ccdf91efc3304c39.gif[/img]
[i]“Shapes and colors the lights of which I’ve never seen”[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]“Meet interesting People they said…”[/h3]

Alright, Flippers, meet Sebastian and Layla. Two new characters from this DLC. 

They're in need of your expert renovation skills. Both have exciting projects and unique visions, and they’re counting on you to bring them to life. Sebastian values efficiency and determination, while Layla is all about ambition and hard work.

They both dream big and look forward to seeing how you can transform their spaces.Where do you think these characters would want their dream renovations? Dive into their stories and help them achieve their goals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/14fb919659c01ee7c1d138f2761ccfb9269b52aa.png[/img][i]Meet our Fiery two![/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]All good things come to an end…[/h3]

Thank you for sticking with us until the very end! We want to use this occasion to inform you that the Steam Summer Sale lasts till tomorrow, so it's your last chance to grab any House Flipper franchise games and DLCs you're still missing! 👀
https://steamcommunity.com/games/613100/announcements/detail/4271182997359351514

Have a great rest of the week and let us know how you feel about the path of development we're taking with Dine Out DLC.

Kudos from all the House Flipper developers! ❤️❤️

notes.title: 🍲 Dine Out DLC: Fresh news!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Flippers![/h3][hr][/hr]Today’s chef’s special is a handpicked lineup guaranteed to catch your eye! We invite you to get cozy at your tables and gear up for an unforgettable tasting. 

But first, sneak a peek at the culinary delights we’ve whipped up just for you.

We'd like to show you a new way to level up your house design with the new mezzanine feature.
We also prepared a quick sneak peek of a new job that will let you step into the shoes of a restaurant renovator and get it ready for sale!
To wrap things up, we're introducing a pack of diverse items that will help you refresh the look of your future projects - both homes and restaurants.

So, let's not let anything overcook - time to take that cake out of the oven!


[h3]Mezzanine![/h3][hr][/hr]Bedroom, office, or your very own cozy nook all elevated to a new level? Soon, it'll be possible with the Mezzanine feature we're developing!
We believe you - the Flippers - are the best to explore its possibilities.

Just so you know, it works seamlessly in every house across the game! 
Here's a first look at our work in progress. Go ahead and share your thoughts in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/23dc2f739d0dcd744a5363193f134095611c71fc.gif[/img]

[b]⚡ NEONS[/b]
Popular as early as the 1920s and 30s, neon signs became a symbol of outdoor advertising. But now, we want you to bring them indoors!
Give your spaces a retro and vintage vibe by thematically incorporating neon signs. Your imagination is the only limit.
Choose from a wide array of variants and adapt them to fit your style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/9ed51053c777940bb37a8a3e87b6c9a27f4b1aff.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/5793b436a4213f9cd776d3fd2ea0127887a8aabb.png[/img]

[b]☕ COFFEE MACHINE[/b]
The rich aroma of fresh coffee and roasted beans drifts through the space, signaling everything's ready to perfection.
Swing open the windows - let the allure of coffee draw in potential buyers with its irresistible charm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/7561883b2c81ecf5c8db45d348113df7edac827e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/704c968d77c08300d9068d05ae675f8686731892.png[/img]

notes.title: House Flipper Status Report 📋
notes.content:
[h3]❤️ Hiya Flippers![/h3][hr][/hr]
I hope you're all doing well on this fine weekend!

We're here today to discuss the situation of the original House Flipper, as I'm pretty sure many of you are aware that [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1190970/announcements/detail/6106382177078964041?snr=2___]the release of House Flipper 2[/url][/b] doesn't mean that we're halting the support for HF1.
Let's do a little dev diary, similar to the one I posted last week regarding House Flipper 2, and check out what's currently happening, and what's the future of the House Flipper franchise!



[h3]🚧 The current situation[/h3][hr][/hr]
For the majority of 2023, we've been focused purely on making sure House Flipper 2 arrives on time. We managed to do that and we're extremely glad and excited, but we understand that with the gaming experience changes that House Flipper 2 brought, [b]some of you still prefer the first part, and that's something we're taking into consideration regarding planning our future development efforts.[/b] 

First of all, we're aware the game is not completely bug-free, and we'll be doing our best to target those pesky bugs in future free updates... let's talk about that!



[h3]🔮 The future[/h3][hr][/hr]
Yup, free updates, you heard that right! We recently managed to build a little plan regarding adding more content to House Flipper!
At the moment we don't want to throw any dates or timeframes at you, as we're still evaluating the amount of work ahead of us, but for now, [b]there are at least 2 free major content updates planned for House Flipper.[/b] As I mentioned, these updates will also bring a bunch of fixes, but some separate small hotfixes are also something we'll be going for. We will keep you updated on those, so make sure to keep an eye out for some sneak peeks!

Now, that might possibly surprise some of you, but the release of [b]House Flipper 2 also doesn't mean the end of DLCs for House Flipper![/b] I can't really tell you too much today, but I can show you a bit! 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/3f3eaa7e2e3a9e7261e4e0c03d30d82bb92df500.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/ba27a61d84bef46405a0bb22a6673f42a74acbf0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/f967cd63b67328d7673d724deed9f410db65ea0b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/3acb6b199eb3db9804100f6bafe8a3571b6ed45e.jpg[/img]

Spicy! I'm sure you can already guess the theme, but let me know your thoughts about what this DLC might be! Any creative ideas are also very welcome in the comments below!

It's worth mentioning, that when it comes to the further development of House Flipper, our friends at Petard Games are now cooperating with our team! They're also getting very close to the release of their long-awaited project called [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330560/Hairdresser_Simulator/]Hairdresser Simulator[/url][/b]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330560/Hairdresser_Simulator/

[b]If that's something that tickles your fancy, make sure to wishlist the game, as the launch is right around the corner![/b]


I would say that's it for now! If you have any questions make sure to post them in the comments as well, I'll try to keep in touch with you there! Thank you so much for taking the time to read this wall of text and I hope it provided some important answers!
[b]Remember that without your help, we wouldn't be where we currently are![/b]

[hr][/hr]Have a lovely rest of the weekend! ❤️❤️

[i]~ Reczberg, together with all the House Flipper devs![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/613100/House_Flipper/

notes.title: House Flipper 2 - Meet the Sandbox Mode!
notes.content:
[h3]Howdy Flippers![/h3]

For the last couple of weeks, we have been thinking about how to better visualize the part of House Flipper 2 that some of you may not know. Till now, we only showcased it during occasional developer streams as well as on a couple of screenshots. Since it's going to be an extremely important part of HF2, we've decided to create a trailer that is going to showcase the vast majority of features available there.

[h3]We would like to fully introduce you to [b]House Flipper 2 Sandbox Mode[/b]![/h3]

We, the devs, created each and every house in our game using the tools found in the Sandbox Mode. 
Now, with the upcoming release of House Flipper 2, it's going to be your turn to sit behind the controls!
Create and share your own custom houses and quests, completely from the ground up!

After you're done, share them with the House Flipper community through MOD.io, and let your friends play through your creations, and complete the jobs you set up for them!
Sharing your creations has never been easier before!

[previewyoutube=tqEgsLm442c;full][/previewyoutube]

We're thrilled to be posting this, as deep in our hearts we have huge expectations when it comes to the Sandbox Mode.

Just as a reminder, House Flipper 2 is going to be divided into 2 modes:
- The Story Mode, which is the one you know from the first House Flipper already.
- The additional Sandbox Mode, which is basically a "House Flipper goes fully creative", as presented in the above trailer. From an empty plot to a 3-story mansion or whatever else you may like! 

Thank you so much for being here with us and patiently waiting for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1190970/view/3676679309281816996][b]release in December.[/b][/url]
We can't wait either, but before that comes, we still have some extra stuff waiting for you, just to spice up the atmosphere and tease you with some juicy sneak peeks.

notes.title: House Flipper 2 Gamescom Report + Giveaway!
notes.content:
Dear Flippers,

This is going to be a little bit of a "behind the scenes" post, as we'd like to delve into the adventures we experienced during most likely the biggest gaming industry event of the year - Gamescom 2023, on which we went for it and revealed the release date for House Flipper 2!

At the same time, we'd like to warmly thank everyone who attended the event and send special kudos to those who visited our booth. Being there really showed us how numerous (the number of people was just crazy!), chatty (loved chatting with you guys about some nostalgic retro game vibes... and about HF2 of course!), and stylish (don't even get me started on the crazy cosplays!) the global gaming community is!


[hr][/hr]
[h3]But let's start from the beginning, right?[/h3]

August 21 was officially the first day of the event... but! A special Frozen District team was tasked with appearing in Cologne a couple of days earlier to make sure everything regarding the construction of our booth as well as the technological support of it goes according to the grand plan.

We all started packing, and the very first of our agents arrived in Cologne on August 19. The next morning, they approached the exhibition halls ready to check and report the situation!
Fortunately, everything about the booth itself looked great, and we had some outstanding PCs waiting for us ready to be unpacked and put into action. The preparations got into top gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/46f8f9d26b7d635d88e82db1789ee907f2f86cdc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/d14ee945eed44255a92a3cf6cda2d7aa89ca5a61.jpg[/img]
The rest of the "Frozen District + Frozen Way Gamescom crew" arrived in the late evening of August 20. After a pretty long trip, we had a chance to get some proper sleep and prepare ourselves for whatever came the next day.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]The action starts![/h3]

The first day of the event was the press day, so it was a bit chill!
We had a great time talking with influencers and press from all around the world, and we had a blast streaming for you live from Gamescom to reveal the release date of House Flipper 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/0eacef28bacf29be704fcab43408bf6718ac4241.jpg[/img]
And then it all started!
With our eyes wide open,
our House Flipper 2 knowledge sharpened,
and our social batteries charged to the maximum,
[b]WE FACED THE GAMERS![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/f0499b78c99cc1818ac59e8081a2981ddf340253.jpg[/img]
Our booth at a constant maximum capacity, going strong, not giving up!
Our defense strategy? Well, we had to come up with some DIY ideas for some tiny issues, and as always the answer is DUCT TAPE! Optimize the queues!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/1fac53252e9ebb8dec813981ddb47dbb2bae1c9e.jpg[/img]
More and more waves of gamers were arriving at the booth. We had a chance to meet lots of newcomers experiencing flipping for the first time, as well as some really hardcore Flippers with hundreds or even thousands of hours of playtime.

I gotta admit that the excitement and energy from the House Flipper fans queuing up to play the HF2 demo and chat with us was on a completely different level!
For the following days, all our Frozen District and Frozen Way warriors were fighting to their absolute limits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/f8e9bd0f96b892846947e6c569657d98e46c3978.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/c0a996014802e66e5f87eb548031ddf8753e98f1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/b5e93916a411a4e3e7993622d8ef74a358b87288.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/8bbea45fdcfc409d26f11f5e0e58b748ec85c7e5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/114f07b265f9a6fc89465b9d6afbcdfd96bc47b1.jpg[/img]
Some have fallen... but thanks to their efforts, more and more gamers were finding joy amongst the plywood walls of our beloved booth!
[i][DISCLAIMER: No developers were harmed in the making of this blog post.][/i]
In the end, our shifts were not that long and we had enough time to regenerate, so no worries!

As more and more gamers were leaving our booth with a bag of merch goodies and their minds (hopefully) filled with positive emotions, we were getting closer and closer to the last day of Gamescom!

On Sunday, it was time to pack up our things, deconstruct our now field-tested booth, and soon after that say goodbye to Cologne! Luckily, we still had a bit of extra time for some tourism before we flew back to Poland.

Overall, the event was... well... it's no surprise that it's considered to be the biggest one in the world.
We left the place with a strong feeling of accomplishment and our minds full of memorable moments with the fans! Once again, we thank you so much, and hope to bring you a fantastic new gaming experience at the end of this year!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1190970/House_Flipper_2/

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Giveaway time![/h3]

Additionally, for those who were tough enough to get to the end of this post, we have a little giveaway!
Join the giveaway by clicking on the image below (or [url=https://gleam.io/competitions/0gXzR-gamescom-2024-report-giveaway]HERE[/url]) and win anything you'd like from the already-released House Flipper franchise content:

[url=https://gleam.io/competitions/0gXzR-gamescom-2024-report-giveaway][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/74ada1a51c68610a1ce67ae75d8cb027acdeb0f8.png[/img][/url]

[hr][/hr]
[i]As always, have a fantastic day!
~Reczberg with a bunch of Gamescom-loving developers from Frozen District ❤️[/i]

notes.title: The Demo Update is here along with new Farm DLC improvements!
notes.content:
[h3]The [b]Demo Update[/b] brings new gameplay possibilities[/h3][hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/23c03d519395277a6133d320479f12db190b59f3.png[/img]

Today we present you a brand new update for House Flipper.
It's actually a unique kind of content, the first one of this type for us so please let us know what you think about it.

For a very long time Flippers had no way to try out the content available in House Flipper DLCs.
We felt like it's time to change that, and create something that will allow you to test the grounds and go for a more conscious purchase.

With this update, you will be able to play some demonstrative job orders from the Garden, HGTV, and Luxury DLCs without having to own them. We hope this will give you just enough insight into the type of content each of those DLCs contain.

[b]What you can expect:[/b][list]
[*]Three new jobs added to base game to show you the mechanics and environments from the Garden, HGTV and Luxury DLCs
[*]Three houses based on the Demo jobs
[*]Around 100 new items such as kitchen sets, tables, cabinets and wardrobes[/list]


[h3]Extra [b]Farm DLC[/b] improvements[/h3][hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/5dc314bafb4f271b3e586714f19be5c54b28a787.png[/img]

Along with the update, we're also releasing a bunch of new Farm DLC improvements, here's the full list:

[b]New additions:[/b][list]
[*]Introduced a new roof type, “Shed Roof” for Farm DLC.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/30de4923ecbd1f78cfb87b2997f79c84f1e003bf.gif[/img]

[b]General fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Significant performance optimization for Farm DLC.
[*]Transparency rendering for Steam Workshop items will now display correctly.
[*]Fixed a problem where the Paint Gun couldn't apply paint to certain individual walls.
[*]Items will now always have a valid variant selected when clicking them for the first time.
[*]Overall reduction in number of crashes throughout the game.
[*]Trees, pavements, and weeds that were previously interactable only when the Garden DLC was enabled can now also be removed while the Farm DLC is active.[/list]
[b]Map fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Fixed item choices not loading in some Creative Quests on Luxury DLC orders.
[*]Applied further map optimizations related to disabling unseen floors.
[*]Pets will no longer freeze in place after reloading a map while they are running on tracks.
[*]Fixed unpaintable ceiling strip on “Hundred Cones” house.[/list]
[b]House Builder Tool fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Returned House Building functionality to houses “This house was on fire” and “Historic house”
[*]Patched up a visible white line between grass and floors of created buildings.
[*]Looking at House Building quest previews will no longer cause substantial performance drops.[/list]

[h3]Lastly we have some [b]Honeycomb[/b] news[/h3][hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/bf2cb4e48b89f7f5f110adbb99bfd7c781d11562.png[/img]

Make sure to visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/][b]Steam page[/b][/url] and see how two developers from our team fare against the challenges of our planet.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/

And that's not all of it! If you'd like to play the Honeycomb demo, we are currently at Gamescom 2023 in Cologne until August 27th. Swing by for a high-five and some potential feedback. We'll be waiting for you at the Hall 10.1 E028.

notes.title: Another bug bites the dust - New Farm DLC hotfix!
notes.content:
Howdy, Flippers!

We've been away for a while, but we're back with another batch of fixes. We're constantly looking to enhance your gaming experience, so check out what's been fixed. 
ps: don't forget to update your game and make sure you have the correct version [release] [b]1.23204 (3e183)[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832960/House_Flipper__Farm_DLC/ 

[h3]General fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed the sorting of newest items.
[*] Stairs will no longer be automatically sold when selling a nearby window.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the full installation of the anti-gravity lift when using a gamepad.
[*] Fixed a variety of wall glitches that occurred when placing two doors in the same segment.
[*] Weed removal quests will no longer appear unless the Garden DLC is installed.
[*] Mobile scaffolding will no longer go out of bounds.
[*] Placing down a Mobile Scaffolding will now automatically reset it to base height.
[*] Purchasing doors without sufficient funds will no longer lead to endless wall destruction.
[*] Painted ceiling tiles will now save their progress consistently.
[*] Fixed loose wall segments left by the hammer during very wide door installations.
[*] Fixed mismatched collisions on “Taggy stacked staircase” item.[/list]
[h3]Animal fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Chickens will now utilize all three nests in the triple chicken nest item.
[*] Added new icons for grooming cows, horses, and goats.
[*] Fixed cyclic frame stutters caused by farm animals.
[*] The AI of farm animals has been enhanced to reduce instances of them getting their heads stuck inside walls.[/list]
[h3]Map fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Increased the size of the Ladder Room in the "Thank You Renovation" order.
[*] Restored missing balcony previews on “Grandpa’s Summer Surprise” order.
[*] Unseen floors in Pets DLC and Farm DLC maps will no longer be rendered, resulting in a notable performance improvement.
[*] Fence previews on “Don't Spare the Horses” order will no longer lose their transparency.[/list]
[h3]House Builder Tool fixes:[/h3]
[list][*] Outer walls will no longer have holes due to previously placed inner walls.
[*] Eliminated significant frame drops caused by large foundations.
[*] Small buildings will now properly cut out grass when placed.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused wooden floor tiles to appear on unmodified buildings after loading a saved game.
[*] First floor of deleted buildings will no longer leave their ceiling behind.
[*] Deleting buildings is now significantly faster.
[*] Mobile scaffoldings placed on the first floor of a created building will no longer be able to fly or disappear under certain conditions.[/list]

[hr][/hr]So, that would be it for today, Flippers! We hope those changes will improve your gaming experience, and you won’t encounter any new bugs.
If you’d like to keep up to date, [url=https://twitter.com/houseflippersim]follow our social media channels[/url].

Have a lovely time flipping!

[i]~ Reczberg, Fufu, and a bunch of grateful developers from Frozen Way![/i]

notes.title: Farm DLC fixes... and sneak peeks!
notes.content:
[h3]Howdy Flippers![/h3][hr][/hr]
We’re still receiving tons of feedback from you, and thanks to your ongoing support, we were able to come up with another hotfix. At the moment we're sitting on 5 major Farm DLC hotfixes, and if you'd like to see all the results of those, head over to the following Steam Discussions topic:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/613100/discussions/13/3832044617120388842/


Today, we’ve prepared a few improvements you’ve asked for, [b]mainly no more issues with snapping in greenhouses with roofs and gutters and additional fixes within the architect tool![/b]

Keep in mind, that even though we're constantly working on more and more fixes, we're also preparing a cheeky content update for all the Farm DLC fans, take a quick look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/80de55a02c99a9b870c05bf4e8df5d8425adaf57.gif[/img]
[b][i]That doesn't look like your typical farming content![/i][/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/e0f0b4906c90626aacc62c575bc639d4eb4747c7.jpg[/img][b][i]This one is a new upcoming job order for the Farm DLC... the devs let me know that Flippers will have lots of work with this one![/i][/b]


Now, before we continue, check if your game is properly updated:
The version that you should see in the main menu is [b]1.23151 (9914e)[/b]

If you cannot see any updates in your library, the version you see is different from the one mentioned above, or you're still facing issues after today's update, try to verify the integrity of game files: 
[i]Go to Steam Library > right-click on House Flipper > Properties > Local Files Tab > Verify integrity of game files. [/i]

We have found that some (corrupted or missing) files cannot be fixed just by verifying the integrity of game files through Steam. In some rare cases, especially when you cannot open the game at all, you might need to do a full reinstall!
[i]Go to Steam Library > right-click on House Flipper > Manage > Uninstall. Then install the game normally through Steam Library again.[/i]



[h3]Here, take a look at the detailed list of today's changes:[/h3][hr][/hr]

[b]General fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Improved the placement mechanics for greenhouses, balconies, and gutters. They now automatically snap together if they are compatible, as long as you look directly at the item you want to connect to.
[*]Restored the ability to paint upper wall segments on most houses.
[*]Resolved the issue where outside quests had a cumbersome navigation menu when the Garden DLC was not active.
[*]Fixed the audio bug with the Paint Gun, which caused it to not mute when all sounds were turned off.
[*]Fixed the problem where farm animals were unable to receive the "Hungry" status.
[*]Fixed a crash caused by the Capulus Bathroom Door.
[*]Froly stairs will no longer infinitely reappear after being sold.
[*]Corrected the recognition of lamp items by rooms.
[*]Adjusted the rotation behavior of windows and doors when placed in Terrace and Balcony room types, they will now differentiate between outer and inner room types.
[*]Fixed animations of the fox seen in the environment.
[*]Fixed crash related to Morgan’s Pets Care popup.
[*]Previews of fence-placing quests will now appear only when holding a fence.
[*]Fixed farm animals freezing due to certain actions without Pets DLC enabled.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/4bd8ac4f304fef3d3b60325b81f16c77b4959f53.gif[/img]

[b]House Builder Tool fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Resolved an issue that allowed singular foundations to be extruded, resulting in infinite loading times.
[*]Fixed the ability to place inner walls inside outer walls.
[*]Money spent on the house builder tool will now be included in the overall "House Renovation" costs during a house sale.
[*]Fixed certain foundation selection methods that caused lone walls to appear.
[*]Addressed the issue where foundations could be built on balconies.
[*]Fixed the infinite loading time issue related to placing a building twice in an order.
[*]Building outside of designated quest area will no longer reset the progress of already placed items inside the building.
[*]Saving progress between building phases will no longer lead to disappearing ceilings and floors.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused holes in the foundation to appear during initial placement.[/list]


If you have any questions about this patch, or you'd like to report new bugs, you can contact us at: support@frozenway.games with a brief description of the issue. [b]We will try to help you asap![/b]


[i]Pssst: For all of you, Flippers, we have a little surprise. Take a look at this bundle. If you’ve ever wanted to make a friend in the Pets DLC and start your farming journey with the Farm DLC, now’s the perfect time![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31350/Everybody_Loves_Animals/

notes.content:
[h3]Dear Flippers, the work goes on![/h3]
[hr][/hr]
Not every hero wears a cape, but to us, you’re one of them! Thanks to your feedback and opinions, we managed to launch another hotfix. 

We’ve heard voices saying that roof placement can cause issues, that you have some problems with the grappling hook, with disappearing houses, and similar-looking piggies. Now you can try our improvements coming with this patch.

[b]Make sure that your game is properly updated![/b]
The version that you should see in the main menu is 1.23129 (6ee7b)

If you cannot see any updates in your library, the version is different from the one mentioned, or you're still facing issues after today's update, try to verify the integrity of game files:
[i]Go to Steam Library > right-click on House Flipper > Properties > Local Files Tab > Verify integrity of game files.[/i]

We have found that some (corrupted or missing) files cannot be fixed just by verifying integrity of game files through Steam. In some rare cases, especially when you cannot open the game at all, a reinstallation will be needed!
[i]Go to Steam Library > right-click on House Flipper > Manage > Uninstall. Then install the game normally through Steam Library again.[/i]



[h3]Here's the list of changes![/h3]
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/03e006023169b9ca03aff5653bebc05250d1b1a2.png[/img]


[b]Improvements and additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Revamped roof placement on House Builder structures. Give it a try!
[*]Added more pig variations to Happy Farm.
[*]Crop collection popups now appear and disappear much faster
[/list]

[b]General fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that caused “The Cabin in the Woods” house to disappear from the buy menu if it was unlocked before the previous update.
[*]Fixed the highlight outlines not appearing on some PCs.
[*]Fixed issues with some items not setting correct room types.
[*]Resolved a crash that occurred when using fences before menu navigation.
[*]Fixed an issue preventing usage of Grappling Hook in the “In Deep Water” quest, “The hall of the mountain king” house, “Paradigm Shift” quest and “Industrial getaway” house.
[*]“Good Ole Wedding Barn” house’s porch edges will no longer block house building.
[*]The invisible borders of “Saturday's Hay Fever” house and “Good Ole Wedding Barn” order are no longer hookable.
[*]Corrected the placement of ceilings in “A Little Brick House” level.
[*]Fixed an issue with Froly Attic Stairs causing crashes.
[*]Fixed an issue with wrongly assigned textures leading to crashes or pink surface.
[/list]

[b]House Builder Tool fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with certain floors on “Don't Spare The Horses” quest, “Sparrow's nest” house, “Paradigm Shift” quest, “Industrial getaway” house and “Poppy House”, which caused performance drops and other major glitches.
[*]Fixed issues preventing the placement of fences on the first floor and on the edges of roofs, as well as the filling out of fence placement inside structures.
[*]Resolved an issue related to editing a building that has stairs, which caused ceilings to be cut out and sometimes closed in the wrong places.
[*]Prevented the player from standing inside inner walls during building construction animation.
[*]Fixed a problem with a broken popup that prevented the House Builder tool from being unlocked.
[*]Fixed highlight outlines that didn't disappear after hiding House Builder on unsuccessful deletion.
[*]Added a separate progression bar when deleting buildings, which no longer freezes and is shown when deleting via shrinking foundations.
[*]Fixed an issue preventing inner swimming pools from being placed inside House Builder structures on some maps.
[*]Blocked building actions during tool switch animation.
[*]Improved foundation shrinking so that it is no longer stopped on each step if foundations are connected to a House Builder structure.
[*]Fixed a corner case leading to disappearing walls.
[/list]

If you have any questions about this patch, or you'd like to report new bugs, you can contact us at: support@frozenway.games with a brief description of the issue. We will try to help you asap.

Due to testing delays, the hotfix for MAC players will be released tomorrow. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
[hr][/hr]
~ [i]Reczberg with a bunch of grateful developers from Frozen Way and Frozen District <3[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31350/Everybody_Loves_Animals/

notes.title: Farm DLC: Post-release survey and another bunch of fixes!
notes.content:

[url=https://forms.gle/acPSSkiZHaAnHkfG7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/998c588bddfbf5dfb985c25df3200dd02f873b0c.png[/img][/url]

- Fillars can now be placed using any rotation angle on the "Don't Spare The Horses" order.
- The laptop button for "Morgan's Pet Care" now displays the number correctly.
- The animation and effect on the Chicken Snack interaction have been fixed.
- Tomato and pumpkin seeds will now have the correct tablet preview.
- Fixed an issue where the flamethrower could not burn most regular items.
- Variant issues related to stairs on the "Industrial Getaway" house have been resolved.
- Getting out of the lawnmower is now easier, the right mouse button is no longer blocked.
- The "Sole Solution" order now includes the seller tool to make fixing mistakes easier.
- Fixed an issue where wall panels and tiles could be left in the player's hands despite changing tools.
- Wall panels and tiles no longer leave grass inside buildings. If there is already grass inside your building, you can reset it using the Builder Tool. Press the left mouse button on the walls to edit them, and then press E to accept without changing anything. The flamethrower can also be used to get rid of grass more quickly. - Radio music now works on Mac computers as well.
- Floor and ceiling tiling is no longer blocked by most item phantoms. 
- An issue preventing tiling balconies and stairs after looking at the ceiling has been fixed.
- Tiling vertical sides of a balcony no longer costs 0.
- Players are now blocked from raising a building while inside the foundations due to quests outside of buildings. This change only applies to orders, not houses.
- The chainsaw highlight is now properly hidden when highlights are disabled.
- The chainsaw interaction is now easier to get out of.

[i]House Builder Tool specific improvements:[/i]
- Fixed an issue that led to holes in buildings when selecting and canceling foundation at the same time.
- Fixed an issue that lead to holes in buildings when selecting not in-line.
- Fixed an issue with floating buildings when merging and placing foundations on stories above ground floor.
- Fixed an issue with wrong floor detection leading to placing buildings inside each other.
- House Builder Tool: Fixed an issue with the price tip not disappearing in certain conditions.

If you cannot see any updates in your library, the version is different than the one mentioned, or you're still facing issues after today's update try to [b]verify the integrity of game files:[/b]

We found a file getting fixed only through reinstalling the game! [b]In some rare cases, especially when you cannot open the game at all, a reinstall will be needed![/b]
[i]Go to Steam Library > right-click on House Flipper > Manage > Uninstall. Then install the game normally through Steam Library again[/i]

notes.title: The second chunky Farm DLC hotfix is here!
notes.content:
[h3]Flippers and Farmers![/h3]
[hr][/hr]We're once again back with a chunk of fixes aimed at the recent post-launch problems of Farm DLC.
This time, we will be fixing some more complex issues as in the last week we asked you to bring us your save files along with any bug reports... [b]and you guys delivered![/b]

We received an insane amount of those, and thanks to that we could quickly locate the most complex post-launch issues. Thank you for being so active!



[h3]Let's go into detail.[/h3]
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/28b5950b1fed5340370291e1ab42fa3d56438656.png[/img]

- Fixed a bug with the order [b]"In Deep Water"[/b] causing an infinite ending screen.
- Fixed an issue with [b]outlines / highlights[/b] not appearing on certain hardware.
- Fixed a bug in the Architect Tool that caused stray thick walls to appear inside homes.
- Changed rewarded cash amount in Farm DLC job orders to more accurately reflect the player's efforts.
- Fixed crashes related to the Forna Cooker Hood, Pavement Cudda, and Taggy Straight Staircase.
- Resolved an issue with wall panels remaining in the player's hand even after switching tools.
- Addressed problems with rain not appearing despite the gloomy weather and other rain-related issues that affected performance.
- Corrected errors in the Luxury Renovation menu's key tips and missing item flipping functionality.
- Fixed a bug where Chajen default lightbulbs would endlessly rush toward the player if aimed at the ceiling.
- Horses now have different colors and can be male as well.
- Audio fixes for Pitchfork, Paint Gun, Alpaca, Yuppi Wardrobe, Havana Commode, Dermallia Toilet, Laptop Fex, Dove Praline Box, Starlet Bunk Bed, Desk Wood, Snowman Cooker, and Imbus Cupboard.
- Corrected the needs display for farm animals, which previously showed blank space instead of "no needs" when animals were satisfied.
- We took care of maps of orders snapping the view into the wrong places when zooming or clicking on certain houses for the first time.
- Fixed materials of the Paxon Cart and Novela Fridge set.
- Resolved a problem with the Haiti items not optimally connecting to walls and to each other.
- Fixed issues with anti-gravitational chickens. They shouldn't walk in the air anymore!
- Fixed a bug with eggs spawning in specific points on the map


[b]Make sure that your game is properly updating![/b]
The version that you should see in the main menu is 1.23111 (bdd96)

If you cannot see any updates in your library, the version is different than the one mentioned, or you're still facing issues after today's update try to [b]verify the integrity of game files:[/b]
[i]Go to Steam Library > right-click on House Flipper > Properties > Local Files Tab > Verify integrity of game files.[/i]

We found a file getting fixed only through reinstalling the game! [b]In some rare cases, especially when you cannot open the game at all, a reinstall will be needed![/b]
[i]Go to Steam Library > right-click on House Flipper > Manage > Uninstall. Then install the game normally through Steam Library again[/i]



[h3]We're constantly working on new fixes![/h3]
[hr][/hr]We are putting all of our effort into bug fixing at the moment, and we hope it's going to be noticeable in your future gaming sessions. We're also working on a big Farm DLC content update coming in the near future, but that's a topic for another time! For now, that's all the news!

[b]Remember that you can always report an issue found in the Farm DLC by following these steps:[/b]
1. If you encounter the bug / crash / freeze, close the game in any way possible.
2. Open windows file explorer (folder icon)
3. Copy the following path: [code]%appdata%/../locallow/Empyrean/House Flipper Game[/code]4. Paste it into the address bar in the file explorer and press "Enter"
5. Locate a folder called "Profiles", right-click on it, and select "Compress to ZIP file"
6. After the zipping process is done, you should see a new zipped "Profiles" folder.
7. Send the [b]zipped "Profiles" folder[/b], as well as 2 files called [b]Player.log[/b] and [b]Player-prev.log[/b] (found somewhere next to the "Profiles" folder) to us by e-mail at marketing@frozenway.games, with a brief description of your issue.



[hr][/hr][i]~ Reczberg with a bunch of grateful developers from Frozen Way and Frozen District <3[/i]

notes.title: The first bunch of FARM DLC FIXES is out!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Flippers![/h3]
[hr][/hr]We know that the release of Farm DLC has been rough for many of you, as there were things blocking your progress, crashing the game for ya, and causing all kinds of different bugs and optimization problems. I feel like you guys deserve an apology and an explanation.

First of all, I'd like to thank all of you guys for reporting the issues you faced. Thanks to all the log files that you sent us, we were able to take a closer look at a plethora of issues and fix them extremely quickly! Other issues, were not so easy to track through the logs, but we managed to fix them anyway!

It turns out that most of the problems happening with Farm DLC were related to its unwanted dependencies on some other DLCs, Pets DLC in particular.


[h3]Let's go into detail.[/h3]
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/456a55bd5d3a0c7016b68042723951d8f907355a.png[/img]

- [b]Getting stuck on loading screens[/b] should now be fixed!
- [b]House photographing[/b] has been blocking the progress for many of you... Not anymore!
- [b]Building from scratch[/b] should now work properly. Go get your architect tool!
- [b]Pouring water for your hens[/b] is not going to be problematic anymore.
- [b]Chicken coop assembly[/b] should be a walk in the park from now on!
- Vastly improved the [b]visualisation of the final position of your roof[/b] during roof placement.
- All the little translation bloopers are now gone!
- Fixed a bug with door and window variants resetting when building house extensions.
- Fixed the pesky grass that was causing problems for players who don't own Garden DLC.
- We've heard that Molly's house had some roof problems. Fixed!
- We took care of the Windmill house loading issue and threw in a few environment optimizations.
- Any problems with scrolling through houses in your laptop should now be gone.
- Fixed a bug related to the ability to build extensions outside the plot.
- Got rid of visual task list errors in case of too many tasks.
- Farm DLC animal icons have been fixed.
- Improvements to bunny movement
- Shop filtering issues have been filtered... hehe!
- Fixed the Freestand Bathtub shop icon.

... and a couple of other tiny improvements and slight optimization tweaks!


UPDATE 17.04:
- Fixed 2 types of issues that were causing a freeze in the photo mode.
- The Farm DLC order map will work smoothly now. No more screen locks!
- Various item assembly issues have been fixed.
- Tiling and painting your balcony floors, as well as platforms works properly now!
- Farm DLC for Mac users is now fully available.


[b]Make sure that your game is properly updating![/b]
The version that you should see in the main menu is 1.23105 (4d8b3)
If you cannot see any updates in your library and the version is different than the one mentioned, try to restart Steam or verify the integrity of game files.


[h3]We're not stopping here![/h3]
[hr][/hr]We will continue to work on additional optimization tweaks and any new issues that arise.
We'd like to thank you for your support and understanding.
Meanwhile, we wanted to say sorry and let you know that because of this situation, we've launched a new sale, so if you'd like to try other House Flipper content while waiting for additional fixes for the Farm DLC, you now have a chance to grab them on some solid discounts:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15013/The_Flipper_Bundle/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26062/Pets_Bundle/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31628/Farm_Bundle/

Anyway, that's it, folks!
Our devs are working tirelessly and will continue to do that in the nearest future, so keep your fingers crossed!
We will be throwing as many hotfixes as we'll have to in order to bring you the ultimate flipping[i] and farming[/i] experience.

Personally, as a community manager, I'd like to thank all the community members who cooperate with us in giving us the possibility to redeem ourselves.
Cheers!


[hr][/hr][i]~ Reczberg with a bunch of grateful developers from Frozen Way and Frozen District <3[/i]

notes.title: House Flipper Free Weekend begins, celebrating the upcoming Farm DLC release!
notes.content:
[h3]House Flipper Free Weekend![/h3]
[hr][/hr]We promised all kinds of cool stuff to be happening around the 5th HF anniversary, and here it is! Today is the day of the first House Flipper Free Weekend ever, as we really wanted to give you something special [b]to celebrate the upcoming Farm DLC release[/b].

If you always wanted to try out the game, or you are on the verge of convincing your friend to get it, now's the best time to check it out!

The Free Weekend event lasts for 4 days in total, starting on April 6th, 19:00 CET / 10:00 AM PT and ending on April 10th , 19:00 CET / 10:00 AM PT.

What also starts today, is the [b]Farm DLC celebration giveaway[/b]!!
And yes... you can win a key to the upcoming Farm DLC, all you have to do is just take part, and cross your fingers! We will be announcing the giveaway winners the day before the DLC launch, so on the 12th of April. The winners of a Farm DLC key, will get it as soon as the game launches the next day!

To join the giveaway, click on the image below or proceed through [url=https://gleam.io/Fsu4H/its-your-chance-to-win-farm-dlc]THIS LINK[/url]!

[url=https://gleam.io/Fsu4H/its-your-chance-to-win-farm-dlc][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/741cb931b78c9d65b2bf28b9b4d94ac307be6a18.png[/img][/url]



[h3]Farm DLC arrives in 7 days![/h3]
[hr][/hr]- 10 new story orders!
- 9 farm properties in a unique environment!
- 3 empty plots for you to build on!
- 7 exciting mechanics, including the possibility of building extensions of your house!
- Over 1500 farm-themed items!
- Farm animals such as cows, sheep, chickens, and more!
- Crop plants that you need to take care of!
- And more... just take a look down below!

Next week is going to be a big one! We're finally about to release the long-awaited Farm DLC, which is one of our biggest House Flipper DLCs ever! The amount of sheer creativity and hours of work spent on this one project is simply enormous, and we're feeling extremely proud.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/bfe817e372a7e9b8706ca6df961c8bba91b95505.png[/img]



[h3]Here are some sneak peeks from the guys at Frozen Way to make things a little bit more spicy:[/h3]
[hr][/hr]If you've ever dreamed of becoming an architect, now it's easier than ever. The Architect tool allows you to build a house from scratch on an empty lot. As one of the most important features coming in the Farm DLC, Architect Tool stands out because of its versatility. Expand your home renovation repertoire by adding floors to your new abode. To make things easier, we created a mobile scaffolding that will make planning and placing floors faster than ever!

[b]PS: You can use Architect tool in most of the houses from the base game and other DLC's.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/517a9b09c23b453d3c7e7d7a39b8809cfa25a10c.gif[/img]
[i]Yep... that's what the empty plots are for.[/i]

If you are worried about raindrops falling on your head  – you can feel safe. Architect tool arsenal doesn't stop on making new floors. You can also create custom roofs for your houses. Every outbuilding from now on will be unique – the kind you design yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/00ec61b522b0fb4ae56b4489cf6f5e9d20d6cd55.gif[/img]

You might have previously seen us showing the drone with picture-making ability. We've decided that wasn't enough and added one more feature – It turns out that you can now water your plants with it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/92404c680ecc78301112888faa11e598e2fd3f06.gif[/img]

To make your farming adventure more authentic, we've included one more item in our game. Now you can build your greenhouse and grow your plants in style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/9e9c69ab3d8fba606cf09149d533da005192e876.gif[/img]

The Farm DLC is not just about house flipping. It's also about the animals we raise and care for. Look at these chickens, – we all know those are little dinosaurs! — sheep, and happily jumping goat, so cute! 
Ahhh, I can feel that rural charm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/45c14ed864ebba553637a1bdef52d6ee972ec48a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/9e423fd0848e2639f321825bcfeff54fd1a68dee.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/f7232046cd9b9b9b0142e4e3009eeeb9cd6805f9.gif[/img]

We didn't forget about house flipper vanilla players either! We've prepared a few improvements and innovations that will debut in the base game along with the Farm DLC release.

Are you feeling tired? Do you need a break from work? Don't worry. We've got you covered. Thanks to the sleeping mechanic, you can rest, skip time, and return for more flipping adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/745daaa77cdabbd84e1aef5aa2ff5936be41d0d7.gif[/img]

Time for changes. We've heard you loud and clear – no more slow tiling. We decided to improve this mechanic to make flipping more fun. From now on, you can mark a larger area on the wall and make it look brand-new with just one click!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1ba003e8d5991277db18c0198cc15364965e3c6a.gif[/img]

We also have something for those who love evenly trimmed grass! The DLC introduces a lot of large plots of land, so we decided to enlarge the mowing area in order to make it faster and more satisfying.

In previous devlogs, we've also shown the increased range of colors we’ve prepared our paints. Expect to find them in the base game as well, after the release of the Farm DLC!

notes.title: Spring Update comes with the biggest Farm DLC news to this date!
notes.content:
[h3]The spring season is so close, and Farm DLC is not far behind![/h3]

I have no idea about you guys, but I'm kind of done with the winter already! Let the spring finally come!
We welcome its arrival with a fresh Spring Update, that you can already find in House Flipper:
[list]
[*] A brand new property, located in some deep woods - a lakeside treehouse!
[*] Players can now lay floor tiles on their balconies, a change many of you asked for!
[*] A set of new light switches to better fit the vibes of your interior designs.
[*] A bunch of interactive blinds that will add a touch of elegance and sun protection!
[*] A broad range of furniture pieces, mainly in a modern loft office style.
[*] Optimization improvements and minor bug fixes that should help with the recent in-game issues. [/list][previewyoutube=jP6s1rJlDAc;full][/previewyoutube]

The spring season also brings us closer and closer to our long-awaited release, which is of course the DLC we've been working on for more than a year already - the [b]Farm DLC[/b]!

Today, on a little surprise developer stream, we had the pleasure to show you lots of different Farm DLC gameplay aspects, [b]and finally announce the release date!![/b]

Lights out, it’s showtime! 📺
[previewyoutube=FxsuW7LbApY;full]<link>[/previewyoutube]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832960/House_Flipper__Farm_DLC/



[h3]House Flipper Farm DLC release date announced - [b]13th of April 2023[/b]![/h3]

It’s official! Get ready for the farming adventure of your life and a new experience in the countryside.
With this grand announcement, we're also proud to present one of the last (if not the last) of the Farm DLC Development Blogs.

Before we proceed to the main course, we’d like to thank you for your support and feedback under the last devlog. 
A long time ago, we showed you an early WIP version of house extensions. Today it’s time for a quick guide to the [b]Architect Tool[/b]. It’s one of the most important mechanics in the game, and now you can see how it's changed from the last time. Besides that, you’re going to see wood cutting and a new way of painting. Without further ado, let’s get Flipping!



[h3]Architect tool[/h3]

Alright, Flippers, let’s start with the basics. First, we need foundations. Use the Architect tool from the menu, and see what you can do with it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1ad68e8d4fd5eb33d20f5a09ddcdceca9a8b0593.gif[/img]

After you’ve reached the desired shape of your extension, let it rise. Wish we could build things quickly like this in real life, don’t you think?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/ff0bf09645767f8d6427178d17485f0d6d9850ae.gif[/img]

Now let’s proceed to the most important stage – connecting the extension with the building. It’s as easy as it looks, just move foundations close to the house, and connect them when the icon shows up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/fad4b283d583a49245587024d875260964c8024a.gif[/img]

But that’s not everything! We thought that you may want to create inner walls with the Architect tool. Now it’s possible. Plan them while creating foundations, and they’ll appear inside your extended house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/0bbd892db0bfabb5a303aad35b40ddb36741d3a4.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/37c2e830531516ee086e0ded47fc6d573ec4276a.gif[/img]

What’s left is to install new doors and connect both houses to make it whole. Now you can enjoy and decorate everything as you desire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/c669ccd6bc3929878fa93d2fe206db7f28eb3dd2.gif[/img]

With creation, there also comes destruction. Our goal was to let you be free with your decisions, that’s why we’ve implemented the ability to cancel the extension, even when it's fully done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/bec1408f76c4fd932d18aede342adcb56413cb22.gif[/img]



[h3]Paint gun[/h3]

Tired of carrying a heavy can of paint? Bored with that slow and manual paint roller? Time for changes! Welcome to the new era of painting, Flippers. Get ready for this unexpected tool, which will let you fasten your work, and make it easy and comfortable. I’d like to present to you our new Paint gun! Fill it with your favorite color of paint, and let’s get started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/90ab2d401ae562a0b3aedeabc7ff916b3e76ac70.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/3a891ffad9e9572545fec7cd214ae3d7c500993f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/d07203e772aae1d42532d9f5f059a01276724154.gif[/img]



[h3]Chainsaw[/h3]

A true farmer can’t work without proper tools. Our next one is a chainsaw. Remember to be cautious, safety first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/44c2394c01fe1c71aa8f57f4514f411e1b3fccb2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/6bdf6f926d856fc3e17e9ac3c23adf25b78625f0.gif[/img]



[h3]Animals[/h3]

We’ve come to the end of this update, but before I close, let me show you those cuties! 
It’s time to feed them, rub them, and love them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/847170c4949ab0ff523f00afcc26e548103ce66c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/9e388381e78ca1bb1c3ca9817b0e94c6f7e833ec.gif[/img]



[h3]Keep up to date[/h3]

That would be it for today’s development update, Flippers. I hope you liked our little showcase and get ready for the exciting day of the 13th of April – Farm DLC release.
If you want to keep up-to-date, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/houseflippersim]social media[/url] and wishlist us on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832960/House_Flipper__Farm_DLC/]Steam Page[/url] to not miss any future updates.



[h3]Last but not least, we're getting close to House Flipper's 5th birthday![/h3]

5 years have passed since the release of House Flipper, so this year is a year of celebration for us! To mark the occasion, we will be revealing surprises we have prepared for our community throughout the year! 

For starters, a special discount for our fans on the House Flipper game and DLCs on Steam! The discount launches on March 7, 2023, at 6 pm UTC:

notes.title: Farm DLC Devlog #5 – Another house? New Character? IS THAT A PIGGY?!
notes.content:
Howdy, fellow Flippers! 🚜

We’re back with our development update a little faster this time, and we’ve got some good stuff around the corner! I’ve always wanted to make an overview of our project, so I guess this time has finally come. 

Furthermore, I'd like to add that in this DLC you'll get a lot of farmer-themed features, not just typical items and jobs. You'll be able to do even more things around your house and immerse yourself in the farming life to the fullest.

However, before we proceed to the main course, I’d love to thank you for your comments and honest opinion on the latest news. It means a lot and helps us focus on things you find important.. Feel free to give us feedback this time as well.

Without further ado, let the show begin!


[h3]New House[/h3]

You must be curious about what’s inside this suburban-looking brick house. Aren’t you? I can’t tell you everything, but be prepared for some tasty, foodie-flipping job! I feel it’s going to go viral on the owner's YouTube channel.
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/d0dbcfa3ae2ba83d855e01eba66add3a1ee2f871.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3]New character[/h3]

That's Lily. You could’ve seen her on our social media channels, but for those who didn’t let me introduce her.
She is known as a perfect wife and a pretty good rancher. But her precious cow, Molly, got lost. As though that's not enough, her barn got damaged. It seems, flippers, that your help is needed.
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/f034d56c51a3ae2c44cb0d74f4e1acba6d9bb4e7.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Mechanics[/h3]

The leaves have fallen, and it’s pretty messy in your backyard. The best thing you can do is to blow them away. Why not use our new tool? Especially for occasions like this, we’ve prepared a Leaf Blower. Make your garden a little windy, and let the leaves fly away!
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1032e1089bb6e6e93498cee94029fa47fc2e8529.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/9f1b3aee33c8c88e1475f9731990f0526624126c.gif[/img]
[/list]
Oh no, Flippers, look! It was so sunny just a few minutes ago! Now it's raining everywhere. Let's wear a coat so we won’t get wet!
As you can see, immersion is one of our goals and that's why we've made a dynamic weather system. There will be a few weather conditions, but now let's enjoy those chill raindrops. 
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/7157aff0226987af67ca928ac3b16a8b0c0147b5.gif[/img]
[/list]
Alright, guys, I don't know what to say... This thing totally blindsided us. The grappling hook jumped out of nowhere in the latest devlog, and you fell in love with it. And here it is! The tool is in its full glory. Let’s jump around and tell us how you like it.
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/f504d8376249562ab968ee7771e30a4e3f94f96c.gif[/img]
[/list]
Take a deep breath, and imagine a warm evening on your farm. You chill on your balcony while taking in the scenery. Sounds pretty cool, right? 
Thanks to our new mechanic, now it's possible. Try to redecorate your outside walls and make more space for our brand new feature. Take a look through the window and see what's outside. We're curious how you like it – the comment section is yours.
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/563cf40dfdbbd9d6deee8b1b83f453514921d67a.gif[/img]
[/list]
But that’s not all! If you want to change the way they look, try putting some panels on them.
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/33f7e61ab04d804e47d4d4567232e25b9cfb1f12.gif[/img]
[/list]

Oink… 
Oh, sorry, it’s just my piggy. Want to know what is so special about it? She has a keen eye for truffles. In addition to its pink skin and twisted tail, she can also find diamonds among mushrooms.

PS: Oh, how I could've forgotten. Every animal in the Farm DLC will give you a special kind of resource!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/cdc8068a0740f4ecb963e4c4d6ab213df674b910.png[/img]


[h3]Items[/h3]

And last but not least, We’ve prepared some new items that will increase your immersion while playing our DLC.

We need more HORSE power! That's why we've made those obstacles for you to test your skills! Jump over them and have fun playing jockey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/13ab2d61ada63ff4abf513c31f918070e2978d24.png[/img]

After the fun, there is always time for resting. Take your horse back to its box and let it chill until the next adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/2eaef2477c3817b01c59a4729f64e89b2f8c1475.png[/img]

We didn't forget about our lovely hens! They're excited about their new houses! I personally love their little homes, and I wonder if you find them just as charming as I do. Let me know in the comments below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/e0b4a152f80f7e0a93ae08decfc75f8f55003caf.png[/img]

Please, don’t hang up yet. I know I’ve already flooded you with awesome new stuff, but do you have a minute to talk about your car’s… I mean, your solar panels’ extended warranty? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/9363e9565b5dea554cdb13887a13fafd95800dbc.png[/img]

Why don’t you take a look at the kitchen? Those shelves are begging you to put some jars on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/d275cb359701538d2537c4d2a389092db283fb28.png[/img]


[h3]Base Builder Fest[/h3]

One last piece of news for you, guys. Steam Base Builder Fest starts today at 7 PM CEST, and our friends from Honeycomb made something cool that you can check out now on their Steam Page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/ 


[h3]Keep up to date[/h3]

Okay, Flippers, that will be it for today. Thank you for your attention, and I hope you enjoyed our little overview. There are even more things to come in the future so follow us on our social media channels and Steam Page for upcoming news.

You can also wishlist Farm DLC here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832960/House_Flipper__Farm_DLC/ 

Meanwhile, have a lovely time flipping.
[i]~Frozen District & Frozen Way teams[/i] 💚
