notes.title: Farm DLC Devlog #4 – A new house is ready. So is the drone!
notes.content:
[b]Howdy, fellow Flippers 👨‍🌾[/b]

I know it's been a while since our development update, but we're back! Last time you've seen a lot of new features and, most importantly, our new trailer. By any chance, If you haven't seen it yet, you can watch it HERE ⬅️

However, first things first. We'd love to thank you for your comments under the last devlog. They're much appreciated, and we're constantly checking and analyzing them. We'd love to hear more from you again, so the comment section is yours.

Let's not waste more time and begin our journey through the fresh news!

[h1]What's new[/h1]

[h2]House/Job
[/h2]
Guys, we can't hide it anymore. There's a job to be done! Get ready for work with the new house we've prepared for you. Clinch the deal and help us complete the renovation. I can't say more, but a little bird told me that a forest ranger is involved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/685fce95d3ef36a2d09a731ffbb086a300df9b7f.gif[/img]

[h2]Environment[/h2]

Let me share some arcane behind-the-scenes knowledge with you now. One does not simply walk into our enviro. That's why I've smuggled out the top-secret footage of a dev hiking through it. It's a once-in-a-lifetime chance for you to see how beautiful it is out there. Join me on this little journey. Enjoy the view, and let us know how you like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1c1fb5d9bf9af446fc461aa9a35739294d083bcd.gif[/img]

[h2]Mechanics&Tools[/h2]

I hope you're not afraid of heights because we're working on something that can change your point of view. In our minds, there was one idea: we can't wait to see how creative you get with this tool! Ladies and gents, we'd love to present a flying drone with photo-shooting ability! Harvest your creativity, and use it to take some pictures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/f8e2d33e9db2fb2c1b99079784f04d5c27fd2266.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/b40dcde8330c6e9cfe4f99d2cebe202780501146.gif[/img]

After you end your creative photography, you can place the fruit of your labor wherever you want! You'll find it in your gallery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/00de81e9bf00ab7729d13b7b1c0ddfbf216de082.gif[/img]

Okay, folks. It is a little unexpected, but we've come up with an idea you might like to see. We still consider if we want to implement it into the game, but before that, we've wanted to know your opinion. I've seen a lot of comments that ladders are too clunky, slow, and simply do not give the hard-working flipper a good time. In a stroke of genius the idea for a grappling hook came at us with its fast-as-light awesomeness! If we add it to the game, you'll be able to move freely like never before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/7d3fae9bca86f00c5dae1f4c6a5b07ad007df6d2.gif[/img]

On your farm, you will have cows, chickens, and even pigs! That's right, we're bringing you all these classic farm animals, like Old McDonald once said: Ee i ee i o. 
As a good farmer, you'll need to take care of your animals. That's why we thought it would be awesome if you could make them happy. Just take a look at that piggy, Oink! 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/e3e3a2c4a2e6bf4ef9ae7a350e1310cbff4af8e4.gif[/img]

[h2]Items[/h2]

Let the Flippers flip the floors. Let the Flippers flip the walls.
They connect at a 90-degree angle. One does not function without the other. Floors and walls are friends forever. That's why we've prepared numerous variations of them for those who want to change their houses from top to bottom. Keep in mind that it's just a tiny taste of things to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/6b52f84ca887d45db5873f0834f719013b2feeea.png[/img]

Ahhh, this development update is slowly coming to an end. Last but not least, we'd love to share one extra thing. Long awaited gradient set is coming! For all those who love to paint, we've got a sneak peek at our beautiful new paints. My favorite is blue, or maybe green. I don't know. It's difficult to pick favorites from amongst your own children! Can you choose your fav? Remember that it's not the whole set; there is more to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/2365e1ba85b2a3090f393cb79ad8d507454f0f1d.png[/img]

[h2]Keep up with the latest news and posts[/h2]

Before we end, we've got pretty cool news for ya! The premiere of House Flipper Pets VR is set! Be ready in [b]15TH OF DECEMBER[/b] to pet your virtual animals, flip the houses in multiplayer mode, and much more!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1839190/view/3654138551393254887][b][Click here to check out House Flipper Pets VR's devlog!][/b][/url]

So, that would be it for today's update, ladies and gents. I hope you had fun while reading about new stuff, and look forward to the future. There is much to come, but we'd love to know what part of our game so far is your favorite. Let us know in the comment section, and keep an eye on our social media channels and Steam page for upcoming news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832960/House_Flipper__Farm_DLC/ 


Meanwhile, have a lovely time flipping!

[i]~Frozen District & Frozen Way Teams
[/i]

notes.title: House Flipper - let the Steam Scream Fest begin!
notes.content:
[i]Hey Flippers![/i]
It's the [i]spOoOoky[/i] season again, and as always, we couldn't just skip our annual update this year! 🎃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/ecd039d8612222b015693957079a29bd5d5d136e.png[/img]

For us, this time is about celebrating the Day of the Dead, and Dia de los Muertos is one of the most important festivals in Mexican culture.
Our team isn't Mexican, and so as outsiders, when we started working on this update, we've only seen it as a beautiful and unique way of paying respects to the dead. And sure, that's correct, but there's so much more to it! We're all happy to say that by creating this content, our team got to better understand the meaning behind the Mexican Day of the Dead. We encourage you to read about it as well - you won't regret it!

[previewyoutube=Kyf9at02QHI;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, for those of you, who're after even more spookiness, we've added an additional house this year, with a bit different, more of a gaming inspiration... get in the game and guess what this inspiration is! 👻


[b]And here are a couple of changes you can expect to see in the game today:[/b]
[list]
[*] A new Dia de Los Muertos-themed job.
[*] A new, totally normal house. We promise you a pleasant flipping experience.
[*] New seasonal items, including Dia de Los Muertos figurines, cat o'lanterns, rugs, and leaves.
[*] A new Bessie plushie. 👀
[*] If anyone is offering you balloons from under your mat, please ignore them.
[/list]

More info on patch notes and any reported issues can be found in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/613100/discussions/13/3493130872651309146]Patch Notes & Reported Issues - Halloween Update [25 October][/url] topic on our Steam Discussions.


We're hoping you'll have as much fun including the new content in your interior designs as we had while working on this update!

[i]Have fun flipping! 
~Frozen District Team[/i]

notes.title: Farm DLC Devlog #2 – Another brick in the wall 🧱
notes.content:
Howdy, fellow Flippers! 👋

Here we are, even more excited than the last time! As the Farm DLC development is heading the right way, we’re once again super grateful for your recent support and all the questions regarding the DLC. We’ll be slowly shedding more light on this project, and this time, we have a little advice for you – sit back, put on some cozy banjo music, and enjoy this building-themed Farm DLC devlog! 🧰

Also, along with the second development update, we’d like to give you a chance of winning some exciting prizes! Let’s not waste any more time, and [url=https://gleam.io/4pCOt/house-flipper-giveaway]ENTER THE GIVEAWAY NOW[/url]! All the details are available in the link or after clicking the image below:

[url=https://gleam.io/4pCOt/house-flipper-giveaway][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/5bf25b0d454f033730e2496991253178939b9d04.png[/img][/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]What’s new:[/h2]


[h3]Mechanics[/h3]
 
Can we build it? Yes, we can!

After listening to your suggestions, we’ve concluded that current apartments are pretty small and certainly a bit too limited at their core. Therefore, check out the new “extension” mechanics we've been working on lately.
Please keep in mind that it's still a work in progress. 🏠
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/9a1f908d1c79154c30053bf14ca6858b80f66a8f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/91d0399c4ad488cb8d28283b144d276cf2fb9c8d.gif[/img]
[i]Let us know what's your opinion about this feature![/i]
[/list]

Stop! Hammer time! 🔨

Tiles, and a bit of willpower, can turn even the most shabby rooftop into a glittering one. Along with our new roof repairing mechanics that we're improving, you'll get a chance to work at heights and make your houses even more classy.
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/241bec278d98dedd93c8fd09580ea47239d2b763.gif[/img]
[i]Feel like a fiddler on the roof, but with a hammer in your hand[/i]

[h3]Items[/h3]

We thought it would be nice to show you a bunch of new items we've been working on lately.

Firstly, we're bringing some new gate models and animations – let us know if you like them. 🚪

Let's not forget about wheelbarrows! A farmer wouldn’t survive the hardship of his work without his loyal one-wheeled friend. Let’s be honest, there would be no countryside without them…

Furthermore, we have a weathercock. Just imagine all the creaking sounds.

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/ca24737aca22212d7acf960226bf4359f14153c1.gif[/img]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/bcd03fc31ce413899cece1ecb83b0678bbabc6b9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/d5c0110c589f133390dd2786cac9ca4817ce6b1c.png[/img]
[i]They can be your gates to the farmer's world[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/a92886107f41ca1df68967dc03988c131f032967.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/68891acfdecd478492a5666b262d810b093642b0.png[/img]
[i]Can you hear the creaks?[/i]


Attention! Cuteness overload incoming! 👀

Sooo, we’ve also prepared some fancy plush toys inspired by farm life. The goat, sheep, horse, and llama will accompany you during the warm evenings as you watch the fruits and vegetables ripen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/015d4b184af7c09f0c11aa346c0548deb923c3ec.png[/img]

If that wasn’t enough, we give you an additional portion of cuteness, presenting more cute plushies! 😻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/65c90d00936e521405adb057d58fa16c663a4653.png[/img]
[i]Make some noise for them in the comments!![/i]



[h3]Environment[/h3]

When it comes to surroundings, we decided to showcase a new farm-themed mailbox that is a part of the Farm DLC exclusive environment. A cute little barn on a pillar! Isn't that astonishing? 📬

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/0d84aedc1f845558b348e375c14eb9647cabc6fa.png[/img]
[i]Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks could say: "You’ve got mail"[/i]


[hr][/hr]
[h2]Keep up with the latest[/h2]

Okay Flippers, we've come to the end of this development update. We hope you liked our building-themed showcase, which shed new light on a few mechanics and items. It would be awesome if you could share your thoughts and feedback.
We've heard your questions about the frequency of our devlogs, so we'd like to announce that a new Farm DLC devlog is going to be coming every 2 months.

If you’re curious how our friends from Frozen Way are doing, we have a little surprise for you! They’ve just released the first-ever development update of Honeycomb! It’s still warm, and you can find some cute animals in it.

Psssst!.. if, in any case, you didn’t add Farm DLC to your wishlist, you can do it here:

notes.title: Pets DLC patch notes #4 – The pets are growing up, no more glitches!
notes.content:
[i]Hello there, Flippers![/i]

As you know, the biggest update for Pets DLC has been introduced less than two weeks ago, but our development journey hasn’t ended yet. Thanks to your feedback, support, and bug reports, we’ve managed to overcome some major problems. It’s very important to us that you engage so much as a community and help us with a bunch of different things. 

Proceeding to the main topic, for many of you, this is vacation time, and you enjoy summer. Nevertheless, we hope that those bug fixes and changes will refresh your gameplay experience as the wind calmly dabs your faces! 

Quick disclaimer: The update will go live tomorrow at 6 p.m CEST, so feel free to check it out and let us know in the comments below what you think of it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/ac28ebf2ae67804bd9b342a56d7b9d91636f46b1.png[/img]

Ok, let’s not waste more time and jump to the business:


[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Adding the ability to select a pet cage option when accepting pets from Morgan's
[*]You can change the name of all your pets in Morgan’s Pets Care
[*]Adding sounds for selecting pet hat
[*]Frequency of dog panting is now reduced
[*]Time required for animals to grow up was reduced by four times
[*]Added X icons to invisible variants
[*]Fixed variants for dog enclosure and dog enclosure gate
[*]Variants added for all Pets DLC curtains
[*]Miniature of wenge color fixed for rope hanging shelves
[*]If the player is in the office, pets will sometimes play with placed toys on their own
[*]Playing fetch mechanic with various toys has been reworked. It now prioritizes the most recently interacted with pet and adds a few randoms, instead of calling every single pet on the map
[*]The friendly kitty in the Home Stretch job now has a name
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed graphics glitches on AMD Radeon GPUs
[*]Fixed phantom pet gate
[*]Price fixed for Dello and Dazzio tables
[*]Fixed possibility of sitting on Gloria poufs
[*]Pet gates variant are correctly previewed
[*]“Home Stretch”: picking up cat looks way better
[*]“Train car”: Fixed immovable painting
[*]Fix turtle looping around one point
[*]Now only one pet would enter bed
[*]Fix locked pet interaction with carrying paint
[*]Fixes for rat behavior
[*]Removing weeds with petrol lawn in quest is correctly counted
[*]The friendly kitty in Home Stretch job no longer has an invalid age.
[*]Fixed an issue with parrots still making sounds with disabled audio
[*]Dogs will no longer be upset and block all interaction when the player takes away carried paint.
[*]Fixed a rare issue with certain cat breeds was blocking Morgan’s Pet Care when generated.
[*]Fixed hats are not highlighting alongside the pets.
[*]Fix issue that made impossible to pickup trashes near pool in Lake Cabin house
[*]Other behind the scenes bugfixes & optimizations
[*]Placed toys will no longer disappear when carried by a dog that was given to a new home or put into Pet’s Hotel.
[*]Pets will no longer attempt to catch/hit toys through solid walls and doors.
[*]Notifications about animal needs are now displayed much earlier.
[/list]

[h3]Announcement[/h3]

But the fixes are not everything! Those who haven’t managed to get Pets DLC yet, there is still a last chance to do so. The 20% discount will end tomorrow, so don't waste more time, and check it by yourself!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26062/Pets_Bundle/

But if you’re the VR enthusiast, you should check another thing that is going through the development stage – House Flipper – Pets VR. Not so long ago, during the Steam VR Fest, we posted our first devlog. Feel free to check it out and leave a comment if you have any ideas of how we can make the game more enjoyable. 

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1839190/view/3118177241239310834

[h3]Keep up to date[/h3]

Aaaaand, we’re fixed. That would be it for today, Flippers. Once again, we thank you, because as we’ve used to say: There is no us without you! You should also check our social media channels so you can stay up-to-date with the updates. 

Meanwhile, have a lovely time flipping!


[i]~Frozen District & Frozen Way teams[/i]

notes.title: Wow Pawsome Update, such content! 🐾
notes.content:
Since the last dev update, we've been repeating one phrase: [i]work, work[/i].

All this effort in order to deliver as many things as possible with the [b]Pawsome Update[/b]. To be honest: without you, there would be nothing, so before we proceed to the main course, we’d like to thank you once again for the enormous amount of feedback, which inspired us in different matters. With every comment you shared, the distance to our goal was shrinking, as we were more and more aware of any missing pieces in the Pets DLC content list. 

Also, thanks to all your recent bug reports, many fixes made their way to the game along with the release of this update. We hope that now the DLC will be as shiny as freshly brushed fur. ✨

Knowing that many of you can't wait for what is yet to come, we say: paws on the table, here comes a new trailer!

[previewyoutube=kaSvbFMXqkk;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]What's new[/h3]

If you like summer trips, the new train-themed house will please you. We’ve heard your voices, and with an adorable squeak, the rats are here! From a distant land across the ocean, the parrots flew here as well. Additionally, three new breeds of doggos and kittens are ready for your love. If it wasn’t enough, a bunch of new pet mechanics, like brushing, hat picking system, and cat treadmills, are coming to the game with this update. Without further ado…


[h3]Let’s begin[/h3]

Crazy, but that's how it goes, the train is coming, so jump on the board! You won’t need any tickets, it’s open for everyone.

This Train-themed house guarantees a trip to your childhood dreams of being a machinist. 🚂🚃🚃🚃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/d28ade79cd13fe90486bbcca695d6082bc6ffd85.png[/img]
[i]Hop into the game and check out the unique interior of this property. Let us know whatcha think![/i]


[h3]New Animals[/h3]

The time has come, many of you have been waiting for it, and they're finally here.
Rattos are here, squeaking quietly with love. 🐀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/2f17dafb3f89d9e47462e1aef520cd2c2f0c44b0.png[/img]


If you hear the flutter of wings, be ready, two new adorable birds have arrived. Those charming parrots will bring color into your home and embellish your time through their mellow voices. 🦜

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/aec9c2c98aa240d931c32a06f4b306fc489e5c79.png[/img]


Do you know that feeling when you’re back from work, and those eyes are looking at you with such mesmerizing joy? It's our fluffy friends, waiting for you to take care of them. With three new breeds of doggos and kittens, you will feel six-time better than winning the lottery. Aren’t they adorable? Try to name them all, and share your guesses in the comments section below. 🐕🐈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/4efdd5fc217b83d2c4d95b4723e10e44da5834d6.png[/img]
[i]Wow such update, very cute, wow[/i]


[h3]Mechanics[/h3]

Now, we hope that you’ve installed an air-conditioner in your house because what we're going to show you now is way too HAT! Do you remember our little cap sneak peek? Now we can show you its final version. Protect your companions from the sun, and make sure you cover their heads when you take them on a job. Here, take a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/a41947c0fc336eedef8d67ad987371062e9af12b.gif[/img]
[i]Don’t forget, safety first! Let us know which one is your favorite. 👒⛑️🎩[/i]


Don't let your pets be disheveled! Wash them and what’s more important, scrub their backs with our special combs, and look how happy they get. They shine bright like diamonds! 💎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/8e64e82a1bbf7ceb0d007cd096c8df9083f9536f.gif[/img]


Ah yes, we’ve brought a new fun and exercising toy too. (Actually, it's already been in the game but we've just added new functionality to it!).
Your cats will love it for sure. They need it to stay in shape, so keep an eye if they practice every day. 🏆🥇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/451f6e367f8e4f7053b075c2b0d4e5f398993992.gif[/img]
[i]You spin me right round, kitty, right round like a treadmill, kitty, right round, round, round.[/i]


If today was a busy day for ya... you know, flipping houses, doing stuff... Now it’s time for some rest. With this new mechanic, your four-legged friends will also take their daily naps on some comfy sheets.😴

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/25e65a3f33b5eccc80fe3104c62f6fbdfbb0b300.gif[/img]


Already on your feet?  Come and check this out!
We improved the user picture mechanics by adding different variants of custom frames and user images. Now is your turn to adjust them to your needs:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/30f1ad7d204fc9797958e738b888947df9e379c7.gif[/img]


[h3]Items[/h3]

For those who love to lie down and wonder, we have something special: a ceiling fan – you might say it’s just an item, but listen to this quiet swoosh. You might get dizzy from that inspirational whirling.🌬️🌪️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/17b0b6fabfa7fe1c14d465aef284ac55473a8c81.png[/img]


If you've ever dreamed of a cozy room in the atmosphere of the Amazon rainforest, you can create such an oasis yourself. With these new plants mixed with your favorite decor, you can now design the most comfortable domesticity! 🌴🌿

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/4c2c914e882f4ab98ea12ca21331a7ba59eb6936.png[/img]


[h3]Keep up to date with the latest[/h3]

As an ending to this development update, we leave our creation in your hands, folks! We’re still looking forward to your feedback and opinions, so throw them at us in the comment section below.

Also, don’t forget to follow our social media, so you don't miss the latest news. Take care of your pets, and your houses, and don’t forget to water your plants!


[h3]Discount[/h3]

If you still didn't grab a copy of Pets DLC (impawssible!), the Pets Bundle ([i]now on a bigger discount![/i]) is your chance!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26062/Pets_Bundle/

Meanwhile, have a lovely time flipping!
~Frozen District and Frozen Way Teams


[i]P.S.

Pssst, some last news. For those, who await the Farm DLC, the second dev update is coming in the near future, so stay tuned! If you haven’t done it yet, you can still add it to your wishlist here: [/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832960/House_Flipper__Farm_DLC/

notes.title: Pets DLC patch notes #3 - No more freezing!🥶 It's summertime after all!🌞
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow Flippers! 👋

Here we are again with a new bunch of fixes! As we’ve mentioned in a previous dev update, hard work pays off - thanks to all of you who let us know about your issues through our [url=https://frozendistrict.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HFS/pages/2847277075/House+Flipper+-+Support+Tickets]bug report ticket system[/url], another patch comes to life! 🩹

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/cdef68b5f615de5ac7b8008234a3822fc3273957.png[/img]

We once again prepared 2 separate lists, one for general fixes and one for house/order-specific fixes.
We think you will be pleased to know that we have focused, among other things, on refining the enjoyment of spending time with your furry friends, as during the last 2 weeks we've taken a closer look at all the animal-related problems you reported.

Check out the following list:



[h3]General fixes and changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Dogs will now properly get dirty over time, depending on their cleanliness-related perks.
[*]Cats will now jump and play on their wall playgrounds.
[*]Fixed the issue where swapped walls weren't saved.
[*]Fixed the issue where pets would spawn outside of their enclosures.
[*]Improved spawning mechanics of pets when changing maps, they will attempt to spawn on the same height as the player if possible, instead of skipping whole floors.
[*]Pets can no longer be put down on roofs.
[*]Added meaningful distinction between male and female Iguanas and changed their animation in Morgan’s Pet Care.
[*]You can now place items on Listan patterned under the bowl mat.
[*]Guinea pigs will no longer spin in place by following the same spot.
[*]Fixed an issue where the parrot would get stuck in some actions.
[*]Fixed player animation repeating when feeding the hamster.
[*]Fixed laying in bed issues for Couch Archaic variants.
[*]Fixed a bug where carrying a pet could allow a player to place multiple laptops
[*]Fixed an issue where cats would get stuck on placed windows.
[*]Cats will no longer completely freeze if you sell a window the cat was planning to jump to.
[*]Fixed an issue with some items being unsellable after your pet stops sitting on them.
[*]Cats will no longer teleport to the next floor or roof after jumping to the window.
[*]Removed visual clutter from some interaction menu buttons.
[*]The dog's jaw will no longer slowly clip through the toy during the catch.
[*]Fixed an issue where a dog would walk next to the toy and just look at it instead of catching it.
[*]Fixed stairs sometimes not generating proper conditions for your pets to use them.
[*]Fixed the movement of pets on some stairs.
[*]Adjusted placement of the Parrot during eating action.
[*]Fixed an issue with being unable to feed the fish.
[*]Morgan’s Pet Care now only has female spiders to take care of.
[*]A slider will now appear in the pet cage selection menu and fixed navigation via pad.
[*]Fixed an issue where the dog’s position will wildly jitter when playing tug of war near weeds.
[*]Pulling interaction will now properly be ended if the dog ends up in the air.
[*]Pulling toys and paint cans will no longer disappear when the interaction is initiated between rooms.
[*]Cats will no longer get stuck attempting to go through the door clap.
[*]Fixed the door being sellable and pickable after a cat going through the door clap.
[*]Fixed tablet thumbnails for variants of tents, a garden gnome, and Euphorbia milii.
[*]Fixed interaction and selling issues for the item, Kevin Small Triple Window 2.5 x 1.45 m
[*]It is now possible to remove plastic bag trash with Seller Tool, like any other trash.
[*]Harper windows will no longer flick after being opened.
[*]You can now interact with the treadmill to call your dog to it.
[/list]

[h3]House/Job specific fixes and changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Business As Usual (Job—Luxury):[/b]
Fixed walking area issues for pets, which made them go into unreachable places.
[*][b]Poppy House (House—Pets):[/b]
Basement stairs that are part of the building can no longer be sold.
[*][b]Snuggly Hideaway (House—Pets):[/b]
It is now possible to install doors and windows on the ground floor around the stairs.
[*][b]Historic House (House—Luxury):[/b]
Fixed stairs being transparent during tiling.
Fixed loose stairs parts sticking out of the ceiling.
It is now possible to leave the house through the front gate.
[*][b]Two in One (Job—Luxury), A Job You Can’t Refuse (Job—Luxury), Closed Laundry (House—Luxury), and Top-notch Apartment (House—Luxury):[/b]
Fixed the issue where ceilings would appear black.
[*][b]Classic Manor House (House—Luxury):[/b]
Destroying walls around the stairs will no longer expose the next floor.
[*][b]The One To Flip (House—Base Game) and The One To Move In (House—Base Game):[/b]
It is now possible to install Mary windows
[*][b]A New Player In Town (Job—Luxury):[/b]
Fixed the issue causing duplicated shutter installation quests.
[*][b]Garage With Bunker (House—Apocalypse):[/b]
Cockroaches/Glass will no longer clip through the floor.
[*][b]Uncle’s Bunker (House—Apocalypse):[/b]
The roof above the entrance will no longer flicker.
[*][b]Alleyway of Lights (House - Cyberpunk):[/b]
Snowflakes will no longer be visible on ECO lightning mode.
[*][b]Garage With Bunker (House—Apocalypse):[/b]
Filled in a hole near the hatch.
[*][b]House After The Flood (House-Base Game):[/b]
Stains on the floor will no longer flicker.
[*][b]Man Cave (House-Base Game):[/b]
Stains in the basement will no longer appear on the minimap of the ground floor.
[*][b]Hucker’s House (House—Base Game):[/b]
Fixed the drastic FPS drop after painting the ceiling below the roof.
[/list]


We also wanted to thank you very much for receiving Builder Simulator so warmly. The release brought new players into the world of property building, and the 82% positive review ratio motivates and inspires the development team! If you haven't seen it yet, check it out below:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26521/Builder_Flipper/

Remember to follow our social media to stay up to date with upcoming updates, and be ready for more exciting content! 🤩

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26062/Pets_Bundle/

As always, have a lovely time flipping!
~Frozen District and Frozen Way teams

notes.title: Farm DLC Devlog #1 - Alpaca in my living room!
notes.content:
Howdy, fellow Flippers! 🏡

Since the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HC4DX5nZrDM]announcement of House Flipper – Farm DLC[/url], many of you have been asking about the current status of our brand-new addition to the flipping family. I can't help but mention that you guys managed to help us reach 140k additions on the Farm DLC wishlist count, and that's already a really impressive number! We’re proud to tell you that we have some new stuff to showcase, but first, we’d like to thank you for your patience and support. It means a lot to have you here with us! 🙏

It’s been a while since our last update, and we've heard that many of you can’t wait to see what’s new, so let’s skip to the good part. notes.title: Pets DLC improvements and patch notes #2!
notes.content:
Hey, Flippers!

As you already know, we're constantly trying to improve our brand new DLC, according to your feedback. Since our last patch notes, we've managed to fix some additional issues reported by our community, but most importantly, we added a teleport mechanic that helps your pets move around stairs. Most of you (if not every one of you, yikes) have been asking for it, so we're more than happy to implement it into the game! Like the previous patch notes, we've prepared a separate list for general issues and house/order-related fixes.

Quick disclaimer: Read till the end because we might have some surprises for you! But for now, let's get the bugs out of our house! 



[h3]General fixes and changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Dogs, cats, and bunnies will now move between floors on their own via internal staircases, with no need to carry them up or down.
[*]You can now put up to two guinea pigs inside one enclosure, instead of only one.
[*]Improved pet randomization in Morgan’s Pet Care and fixed the issue with new pets not generating in the next refresh cycle if all of them were taken by the player.
[*]Cat hairballs are produced much less frequently now.
[*]Adjusted mouth position of held dog toys and held paint cans to better fit each dog.
[*]Your dogs will now drop held toys when you open their interaction menu, in a similar fashion to dropping held paint.
[*]Your dogs can no longer carry paint when holding a toy in their mouth and vice versa.
[*]Fixed paint cans having collision when carried by dogs, as well as randomly disappearing when carried in rare instances.
[*]Fixed the issue with turtles getting stuck spinning indefinitely.
[*]Fixed issues regarding feeding the turtle, the food will no longer disappear and interaction will properly fill out the bowl without the need for multiple feedings.
[*]Fixed positions of cats laying on objects.
[*]Rebalanced the timing of the pet needs and their behavior on jobs.
[*]Fixed pets changing their colors when the game is reloaded.
[*]Fixed some doors with little pet doors not having their intended functionality.
[*]Fixed an issue with being unable to feed the hamster.
[*]Fixed hamster’s cage keytips.
[*]Fixed house recognition issues when the player is on the roof.
[/list]

[h3]House/Job specific fixes and changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]The AnimalCaretaker:[/b]
Fixed the issue with door frame deletion causing the wall to be filled out despite another door frame being present.
Fixed issues related to selling the bathtub and its mounting point.

[*][b]Lets Rock Right Meow[/b]
(House) - Fixed wall near the balcony on the second floor being unpaintable.

[*][b]KameHouse:[/b]
Adjusted walking for pets, preventing them from floating in the air.
[/list]


Okay now... How about the magic trick? From now on, you don't need to carry your doggos, kitties, and bunnies anymore! We gave them a pinch of magic so that everyone could feel a little Harry Potter vibes! As mentioned above, teleportation is a real thing. It's a kind of magic, isn't it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/f20cf8369160482f3920cba20705855b28c50e58.gif[/img]


Some while ago, we’ve shown you that you’ll be able to have two guinea pigs in one cage. Unfortunately, due to dozens of things we had to do before the release, we didn’t manage to prepare it on time. Today everything changes, though. Two guinea pigs in one cage? Hold my beer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/6b552f56ba5556de29e18cbcb90e3f15bfbfbd38.gif[/img]


The sound of drumrolls echoes through basements and pipes, and you already know something is coming! Suddenly, you realize that below this message, you can find a long-awaited friend that will come with a future update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/e55c2317432e4ffebf77f7d75bbbc67ed6c4bb42.gif[/img]


If house flipping wasn't enough, we have fantastic news for you! Frozen Way, as a co-producer of Builder Simulator, gives you a once-in-a-lifetime chance to create your own house from scratch! Get to grips with construction and feel like Bob the Builder!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120320/Builder_Simulator/


Additionally, before you go, we have a little survey about your favorite (and least favorite) House Flipper NPCs. If you'd like to share your opinion with us, just click on the image below:

[url=https://t.co/fp0jlAewAv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/2f4068d3a6920f1b5d8e4d421b97fe47a2b33dc0.png[/img][/url]


That would be it for today’s development update, flippers. If you have any questions or ideas regarding House Flipper – Pets DLC or Builder Simulator, feel free to let us know in the comments below or on our discord channel.

Have a lovely time flipping!

~ Frozen District & Frozen Way teams!

notes.title: Pets DLC post-release news - Thank you!
notes.content:
Hey, Flippers! 👋

Although House Flipper – Pets DLC was released on May 12th, 2022, it doesn’t mean that our work has been finished. Since launch day, we’ve received great feedback from you guys, and we’ve managed to fix most of the bugs and issues that players have encountered while playing our brand new addition to the flipping family. Before we jump straight to the list of hotfixes, we’d like to thank you for the warm welcome we’ve received so far. 
By the time of writing this update, 90% of you have enjoyed the DLC. Thank you for supporting us through all the positive reviews, and again, thank you so much for being with us – we wouldn’t be at this place without your help. 

When it comes to hotfixes, we’ve prepared a general list of issues, and a separate list containing detailed information about specific house/order-related issues.



[h3]General fixes and changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Scaffolding can now be placed below the ground level.
[*]Fixed duplicated button tip in the intro.
[*]Updated visuals for the gender view of your pet.
[*]Now each toy has a ghost left behind when picked up, as a preview of where it would return if you hid it.
[*]Thrown toys picked from the ground will appear back in their place when thrown outside of bounds.
[*]Picking up the toy when it's in the air no longer results in infinite duplication.
[*]Reloading the map no longer duplicates all thrown toys.
[*]The interaction menu no longer duplicates thrown toys.
[*]Losing the pulling game with your dog no longer results in toy duplication.
[*]Carried toys will no longer break when bought on a roof or other places without a floor in front of the player.
[*]Toy landing in grass no longer results in a cut patch left.
[*]Fixed mouse toy being too efficient at cutting weeds, but now other thrown toys are capable of it too.
[*]Rope of the cat rod no longer bounces endlessly.
[*]Cat rod no longer changes your field of view after hiding the tool.
[*]Pulling Rope interaction now shows the key tip correctly.
[*]Hands no longer change size after pausing and unpausing while your FOV is different than 60.
[*]Fixed validation for pet name, sO yOuR tExT nO lOnGeR tUrNs InTo SoMeThInG lIkE tHiS wHeN yOu HoLd sHiFt.
[*]Now your helper dog will put the paint down if interacted with.
[*]It is now much easier to give paint to your dog, without your dog being busy when standing still.
[*]Fixed ceiling lamp changing position when loading a save.
[*]Fixed Cutibaly Enclosure’s and Vitto Garden Hammock’s missing materials.
[*]Fixed error causing pets spawning on invalid floors
[*]Fixed tiles having wrong names.
[*]Fixed potential bugs caused by butterflies.
[*]Pets will no longer cause optimization issues without being present.
[*]Pet Gender is now visible on the interaction popup.
[*]Fixed some issues related to pet fence gates.
[*]It is now possible to name your pet while using a pad.
[*]Fixed cleaning achievement not considering a small bathtub as valid.
[*]Fixed crash related to pet eye randomization.
[*]Fixed pet randomization in Morgan’s Pet Care, the choices will be more varied now.
[*]Your pets will no longer turn invisible randomly after placing a wall inside a house.
[/list]

[h3]House/Job specific fixes and changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Let's rock right meow: [/b]
(House) - Added ceiling to the small roof at the top.
(House) - Fixed unpaintable ceiling on a small roof.
(House) - Fixed unsellable electric sockets.
(Job) - Fixed candle position.
(Both) - Adjusted spawn position of the player.
(Both) - Pets no longer fly near the garage.

[*][b]Grade-A renovation:[/b]
(House) - Fixed object container attachment, causing wrong shop view.
(Job) - You can now sell the remaining wall materials after you’re 100% done with the corresponding room.
(Job) - You can now sell the scaffolding after you’re 100% done with the furniture on the upper floor.

[*][b]A chance to change:[/b]
(Both) - Fixed Grass Placement to remove grass flickering.
(House) - You can now paint the wall bits above the garage and the terrace.

[*][b]Quality upgrade:[/b]
(Both) - Adjusted collision of grass mower to fix window placement blocking.
(House) - Enabled window and door placement in the corner of the ground floor.

[*][b]The animal caretaker:[/b]
(Both) - Fixed gravel placement by adjusting ground position.
(Both) - Fixed floor material in the garage.
(Job) - Now requires twelve fences instead of only one.

[*][b]Home stretch:[/b]
(Both) - Fixed ground position to remove the visible gap between the floor and the void.
(House) - Enabled window and door placement on blocked walls on the ground floor near the garage.

[*][b]More freedom:[/b]
(Both) - Fixed missing roof collider.

[*][b]Pets haven:[/b]
(Both) - Grass can now be cut.
(Job) - Fixed Mechin doors being assigned to the wrong room in the job.

[*][b]Stowaway tenant:[/b]
(Both) - Fixed Attic Beam position to allow proper placement of ceiling lamps.

[*][b]Kame House:[/b]
(House) - Adjusted walkable area of your pets.
(House) - Fixed pets getting stuck in the boat.
[/list]


We still highly encourage you to send us all your feedback regarding Pets DLC. If only you spot anything that might look weird to you, feel free to let us know on our discord channel.
 
Although this update focuses mainly on bug fixes, we’d also like to ask for your opinion! Many of you have wondered why pets (especially dogs and cats) wouldn’t follow you on stairs. At first, we weren't sure about this, since stairs happen to be dangerous for animals, and surprisingly, this kind of mechanic would also be pretty problematic from the technical side. Nevertheless, since the release, we've received a huge amount of requests, so we’ve come up with an idea which you can see below:
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/5691b367a7697607f0278bbae07a8f9eabc41382.gif[/img]
[/list]Do you think we should implement this mechanic in that kind of form? Let us know in the comments below!


Last but not least, I personally talked to literally everyone involved with the development of Pets DLC on the release date... believe me, the stress was real, adrenaline pumpin, expectations were high, but we made it! Both the Frozen District and Frozen Way are extremely grateful for all your help and support guys, so once again... [b]Thank you![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/79a31b47d40e6f39ae5b59215ee794afa5ba6188.png[/img]

That would be it for today’s development update, flippers. If you have any questions or ideas regarding House Flipper – Pets DLC, feel free to let us know in the comments below. 

Also, don’t forget that Pets DLC is currently on a 10% discount, so don’t hesitate to grab yourself a copy:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569190/House_Flipper__Pets_DLC/

Have a lovely time flipping! You guys are the best!
[i]~Frozen District & Frozen Way teams[/i]

Imagine you're one of the [b]B.U.D.D.I.E.S[/b] living in New York with a bunch of the craziest people on this Earth. Strangely enough, someone is literally recording your life on camera, you're going viral all around the world, and people are obsessing over some weird gadgets with your face on them. Finally, it's the 1st of April, and it looks like your apartment appears in the [b]BEST GAME[/b] about [b]RENOVATING HOUSES. [/b]Geez, what a life! 

I'm counting on you to [b]FLIP THE HELL OUT OF THE NEW APARTMENTS[/b], guys! 

[previewyoutube=7OqSuLaU-kM;full][/previewyoutube]

Do you remember Turtle House from last year?[b] This time, we're releasing not one but TWO BRAND-NEW APARTMENTS! [/b]

[list]
[h2][b]New:[/b][/h2]
[*] Two new, quite friendly houses to flip!
[*] A new TV with hanging and standing mounting.
[*] Desk accessories.
[*] A lot of vinyls with timeless classics, like "Flip Me Baby One More Time", "Main Menu Theme" and "Hammer Time".
[*] New sizing options for Kevin window.
[*] New armchair in Emily set.
[*] A few designer helmets that can also be used as saucepans.
[*] Fridges and ranges in retro style.
[*] New sports equipment: football, hockey sticks.
[*] Doggy and turkey statues.
[*] New doors in all colors.
[*] A new rack with various variants.
[*] A new sofa.
[*] Just a regular armchair with no surprises.
[*] A retro armchair with a footstool.
[*] A new plushie. Haunting entity not included.
[*] A new carpet and panels.
[*] Two new tables and a tea table. You can't drink coffee on this one - it's a major offense.
[*] A landline phone.
[*] A loft window in three sizes.
[*] Pastel variants for all Snowman kitchen set items.
[*] New in Snowman kitchen set: sinks and a cabinet.
[*] New sizes for Gustum kitchen set shelves: 9.75, 15, 20, 25, 30, 50, and 69 cm.
[*] A bunch of color cosmetics with accessories.
[*] Three new posters. They will post all the time.
[/list]

[list]
[h2][b]Changes:[/b][/h2]
[*] False advertising removed - the DLC filter will hide categories if there are no relevant items in them.
[*] (Luxury DLC) The Fazzo Chair renovation process was simplified (Forgotten Heritage job).
[/list]

[list]
[h2][b]Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[*] The poinsettia will now be considered a valid choice in the "Christmas cleaning" job.
[*] Buyers won't dislike things they like anymore unless they don't like them.
[*] (Apocalypse DLC) Apocalypse buyers will share more information about their preferences, like plants or zombies.
[*] (Garden DLC) The pool shouldn't get scared and hide inside the house in "Job: Lawn and pool" anymore.
[*] (Luxury DLC) We've fixed the ocean evaporation speed in "Historic House".
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/9ba269f1a10d814012e815a401b9ae6c09971f3f.png[/img]

As for the Steam Cloud issue - we've been a little bit inactive here for the last couple of days as we're just simply trying to figure out what goes wrong for those of you still experiencing Steam Cloud issues. We've been trying a handful of actions looking for a solution, but after going through our whole Steam Cloud configuration for House Flipper, it seems that everything should be working as intended.
That is why yesterday we decided to contact Steam staff for further research on the problem, and at the moment, we're waiting for their answer.

I will keep you informed when we manage to find any clues that may lead us to the source of this issue. 

[i]All the best,
Frozen District Team[/i]

notes.title: Pets Development Update #4 - new mechanics and more!
notes.content:
[b]Hello there, Flippers and pet lovers![/b]

It's been a while since our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/613100/announcements/detail/2892990276649287714]last Development Update[/url]. We showed you many excellent features, including screenshots of animals (which is not a surprise, actually), Guinea pig's house, bird poo, and more animations. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/443eeba956b298b54281a1447702d6aeb698d5ba.png[/img]

This time, we will show you some ways to decorate your ceiling and how you can use light bulbs to brighten your house. What is more, we have also managed to prepare a short behind-the-scenes video, in which you will see the process of creating sounds for our upcoming Pets DLC. Last but not least, our team of developers took part in PGA 2021, where they have presented Pets DLC in action, so if some of you missed this event, this would be a good chance for you to catch up. Without further ado, let's get started!

First of all, we have put some work into making the process of signing a doghouse as comfortable as possible. However, since we have received a lot of great feedback from our community, we would like to ask what you think about it? Feel free to leave your answers in the comment section below. Second of all, since Pets DLC will bring up dozens of possibilities to make your house cozier, we couldn’t forget about preparing well-suited light bulbs. They are one of the most crucial parts to make your house as comfy as possible. In the video below, you can see just one of the many ways to use them to enlighten your interior environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/d308a2f5adaca95c46cd67f405e71e029940097a.gif[/img]

So far, we have only shown you screenshots, animations, and videos showcasing some mechanics available in the game. However, since our upcoming DLC will put a significant emphasis on being as cheerful as possible, it’s probably high time to show you a short but pretty cool behind-the-scenes video, in which you will be able to see some creative ways that our sound designer used, to create sounds, that will be available in the game. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OzbMw1U-KvU
As you already know, in October our team of developers took part in PGA 2021, where some of you had the opportunity to check the game, leave your feedback and simply give us a high five. We are also aware that some of you weren’t able to attend the event for some reason. Thus, we did our best to prepare a video, which allows you to have a glance at the main features that occurred during the PGA 2021. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pysXLrN66pA
That would be it for this Development Update. We will see you in another one, which will be coming in about two months from now. Meanwhile, if you don’t want to miss any future updates regarding HF: Pets DLC, please make sure to [url=https://www.facebook.com/HFPets]follow us on our social media channels.[/url] To finish this post, we would like to thank you again for your support, and we hope that you have some lovely time flipping.

We've worked on this content for so long, and we were so worried you're not going to like it as much as we do, and we couldn't be more wrong. You guys loved it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1232cc9fed1482369ae4e95d4cce5fc5c8804459.png[/img]

It means a ton, so all we wanted to say is [b]thank you! [/b] We could continue about our gratitude, but there's just no point in that - we're speechless anyways.

It's completely normal in game dev industry to have some bugs in the game, and it's no different this time. We have nearly 120 testers, but it's nothing compared to millions of players out there - that makes it impossible to predict every bug possible. 
We just want you to know that we're working as hard as we can to figure stuff out and fix it immediately - our first hotfix went live just an hour after the release of the Luxury DLC, and we intend to keep this up. 

We're not going to rest until the whole thing is just perfect.

[i]All the best,
Frozen District Team[/i]

notes.title: House Flipper - Luxury DLC is OUT! Moonrise Bay awaits you!
notes.content:
[i]Hey Flippers![/i]

In yesterdays announcement we've talked a bit about Luxury being the biggest DLC we've ever created and how excited we are - well, we had no idea how hyped we'd be today! 

[b]You can now play House Flipper - Luxury DLC[/b] - Moonrise Bay was a huge challenge for us and I think it's safe to say you'll have fun discovering it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/14eec4f9eaf3608aa3043be8bb78f597d641ab01.png[/img]

Also, we want you to know that our work on House Flipper - Luxury DLC is nowhere near done! My job as a Social Media Manager is to gather your feedback and to share it with the rest of our team. Every release is a learning expirience for us and we want to make the most out of it! 

We're aware that the most of you will buy the DLC shortly after the premiere, which is why we wanted to give you a small gift to celebrate the game. [b]You can buy Luxury DLC for 10% off for the day! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1021110/House_Flipper__Luxury_DLC/

[b]About the DLC: [/b]

No more small houses with dozens of little rooms - size is what really counts! Glass roofs, plate glass windows for walls, and a ceiling many feet above your head - this is how kings live!
Take run-down tenement houses and old industrial buildings - factories, large commercial buildings, and warehouses - and turn them into luxury apartments.
With the Luxury Flipper game expansion, we are putting right into your hands dozens of types of new furniture: classic contemporary, antique and modern. The multitude of varieties of color and modular sets will allow you to modify any room to fit your vision of the perfect home.
Utilizing classic furniture doesn't mean giving up comfort! With smart devices, you can control your entire home! Change the colors of the lights, close and open the doors - all that without even getting up from the couch.

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] 12 brand new orders,
[*] Hundreds of unique items in many variants and luxurious styles,
[*] Brand new mechanics: renovating antiques and in-door swimming pools? Sure!
[*] New narrators with a variety of personality traits,
[*] City apartments, yachts, lofts, and other types of houses to flip
[/list]

Also, don't forget to share screenshots from your trip to Moonrise Bay! 

[i]All the best,
Frozen District Team[/i]

P.S. Here are the patchnotes: 

[i]New:
- Windows can be uninstalled. And installed. Even if you're playing on Mac.
- Hardcore gamers may now disable highlights in settings.
- A whole lot of new items: dress form, elevation panels, new paints, a poster (Karakan Twins), a wallpaper (Painted flowers), Madame set addendum, new brick walls, Mememo shelf variations, modular tool board, new shelves, new doors, new Gustum set options, are you still reading this, carpets.

Changes:
- We've reduced the atmospheric density. As a result it's now possible to assemble items in more narrow places.
- The aim dot won't escape from the UI hiding mechanism anymore.
- Numpad enter is now recognized as enter. Numpad lovers rejoice!
- The tablet operating system was upgraded to the latest version, which includes: faster loading times for large categories, "Buy now" button and variants memorizing.
- The latest wall painting fashion spreads among your customers: painting window alcoves may now be optional.
- Light switches can now be moved. Don't try this at home, though.
- Glass shards should be more visible.
- Chinese, Japanese and Korean fonts with higher resolution.
- (Apocalypse Flipper) Flamethrower won't be able to burn water. It won't work on cars and scaffolding too.

Fixes:
- Saving system got a bit more robust.
- Plumbing should no longer penetrate the floor.
- You may place items on the stove.
- Placing items between rooms won't cause them to enter the ghost realm.
- We've caught kids responsible for drawing graffiti on "Boring House". They're not supposed to do that again.
- (Garden Flipper) The house in the "Garden after building the house" should keep it's walls colors.
- (HGTV) Water filter was removed from tablet camera - ocean will now be visible on the photos.
- (HGTV) Various improvements were applied to before-and-after photographing.
[/i]

notes.title: Pets Developement Update #3 - thanks for being here with us!
notes.content:
[b]Hey there, Flippers and pet lovers![/b]

It’s been two months since our last development update, so we thought that it is high time for us to let you know what we are working on right now. Before we start, we would like to [b]THANK YOU VERY MUCH, for all the support that we have received so far.[/b] Furthermore, we would like to announce that we have reached a goal, which we haven’t dreamed of — more than 150 000 of you added our DLC to your wishlist. We have no words to describe how we feel right now! Once again – [b]Thank you![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/cc86df982a2b211b24fa5c79b1e10ea643616b94.png[/img]

In our last Pets DLC Development Update, we showed you a mix of things. This includes animal animations, some fancy-looking furniture, fur (oh gosh, I am still having nightmares), and lovely turtles. What can we show you this time? Well, this time it’s going to be way more fun since we have prepared a little stinky surprise for you! What is more, since we love to have our community involved in our projects, there will be a couple of questions we would like you to answer, so without further ado, let’s get this party started! 

First of all, we have managed to prepare some sweet sets of animals, in case some of you would like to create a friendly and lovely foster family for them. Take a look at a couple of examples here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/2c3a0b53e7811f777cb8f26e3fb206fa3243593a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/7717489903418384d042fe906cec3ecce8a31dfe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/37ffcac8df2b5d0421967b19560d773781b9490d.jpg[/img]

[i]Aren’t they cute? Also, please let us know in the comment section below, how many types of animals you would like to have in your house at once.  
[/i]
Second of all, the house available for Guinea pigs is nearing its final shape, although there are still a couple of things to do here. Please remember that work is still in progress, so expect more screenshots and information in future updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/5d0f161a1fb5947db8ccc8bb326bfba9dc3fd306.png[/img]

And here comes the stinky surprise, that you all have been waiting for! To make the game more realistic, we’re also working on an inseparable element in the life of every human being, which is… bird poo! Oh, yeah! Who doesn’t love some good bird poo on their car, hmm? But, since we have emphasized such details, we would like to know, what do you guys think? Which of these bird poos look best? Let us know in the comment section below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/4e9c039059ff741aec7a7a83c7c95d10bf8f02de.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/4647ee0a09acfa7755440ff272288a2e9c57b536.png[/img]

[i]In case some of you are wondering — birds (in this particular example pigeons) communicate with each other, so if you see multiple bird poos on your car, that’s probably not a coincidence :) [/i]

Another thing that we would like to show you in today's update is quite huge. Actually, it’s not just huge — it is the biggest house available in the Pets DLC. I can assure you that there are more such buildings in the DLC, so stay tuned for further information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/68871c2b3c0b6f0aab71fe448e295d9111be18ed.jpg[/img]

There is a common saying that a dog is a man’s best friend, but we can’t forget the responsibility of having one. We not only have to provide them food and water, but we also need to remember to wash them. We all know that sometimes it can be a tough task to do, so in order to help your four-legged friends with such a thing, we have prepared a special dog washer. Check this out below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/ba225ca768593447630ec7f70431b38c1fa69f39.png[/img]

Speaking of water, most of you know that dogs use to shake off the water. Curious about how it looks in the game? We have got you covered. Check this cool animation out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/5a81a8b73e7932ed866e891b06eff1c0dfb5bd32.gif[/img]

Also, we have managed to do some work on pampas grass as well. From small to medium, finishing with the bigger ones, they can be a nice, decorative addition while being easy to grow. Check them out below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/bef8f9b43d786398fbec514feb84cff93a9ebf2c.png[/img]

Okay, okay, it’s probably high time to show you some more cool animations our team has prepared. In the previous development update, we have shown you some basic animations, but it is time to move forward and show you the advanced ones. Here is the animation of a dog scratching the doors (well, I assume, that you have already guessed what is the reason behind it): 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/273f7548556bae1b373f0497de456f6dfbfe060f.gif[/img]

And last but not least, we would like to show you… well we won’t tell you, since we would like you to test your guessing skills a little bit. Can you guess what will be in there? Feel free to write down your answers in the comments below :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/78bb047c8639899b17905c29c3965b8a59456009.png[/img]

That would be it for this Development Update. We will see you in another one, which will be coming in about 2 months from now. Meanwhile, if you don’t want to miss any future updates regarding HF: Pets DLC, please make sure to follow us on our social media channels. To finish this post, we would like to thank you once again for your support, and we hope that you have wonderful flipping. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569190/House_Flipper__Pets_DLC/

If you have any questions for the Frozen Way team, please do not hesitate and leave them in the comments below. We will do our best to answer them all. Meanwhile, we hope you have a wonderful day and weekend full of joy and chill, just like this parrot has.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/3bcc80fdcb14999dd043a62f6afb59036db3acd6.gif[/img]

[i]Happy Flipping,
Frozen Way Team
[/i]

notes.title: House Flipper FAQ with Bessie the Beaver!
notes.content:
[i]Hey Flippers! [/i]

A few days ago on our Social Media platforms I asked you guys if there's anything you want to know about the game and you delivered a bunch of amazing questions! [b]I gathered some of them and added to the already existing FAQ created by Lizzums - one of our amazing discord mods![/b]
I hope you'll find the answers to all of your questions - if not, I'll be happy to update the whole thing once in a while. 

[b]Oh, and also - [u][url=https://gleam.io/RA8zG/we-appreciate-you]here are the results of our latest giveaway! [/url][/u] I'll be emailing you guys on Friday, 17th! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/9cf561cfdc1df5b1a17c70ce89a7375db0d2d2a9.png[/img]


[h1][b]FAQ[/b][/h1]

[u][b]Let us paint the ceilings![/b][/u] 

[i]We'll see about that in the future. <wink, wink>[/i]

[u][b]Can you add XYZ to the game?[/b][/u]

Give us some ideas and we'll see what we can do! Our Social Media Manager will create a survey for you to suggest new items! (coming next week probably)

[b][u]Can you show us some of the upcoming items?[/u][/b]

Yes we can! Just not today - we'll be posting some huge Luxury DLC spoilers soon!

[u][b]Can I create new paint colors on my own, please? [/b][/u]

We wish it was that simple! Coding the color wheel is something we thought for quite some time, but there's nothing we can promise for now. Sorry! 

[u][b]LUXURY DLC WHEN?1!?!?!?!?!11!! [/b][/u]

It’s coming! We recently announced a release date of 14th October for the Luxury DLC with absolutely loads of new content for you guys. We hope you’ll love it as much as we do! 

[u][b]What platforms is the game available on? [/b][/u]

House Flipper is available on PC (Windows and MacOS via Steam, Gog and Epic Games), Playstation 4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, iOS and Android. Please note that the Mobile (Imaginalis) and Nintendo Switch (Ultimate Games) versions of the game are not developed by Frozen District and so we can not provide support for these versions of the game. 

[u][b]I have a technical issue! What do I do? [/b][/u]

Well, first of all, check out this handy-dandy troubleshooting guide [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/613100/discussions/6/3122660456797813386/](here)[/url] and see if it helps you resolve your issue. If you still have problems, you can file a support ticket [url=https://krej-net.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HFS/pages/2847277075/House+Flipper+-+Support+Tickets](here)[/url] and someone will assist you as soon as they’re able! 

[u][b]When is <enter the name of the expansion> DLC coming to console?[/b][/u]

[i]<starts to sweat>[/i] Uhhh… eventually. Unfortunately, we don’t have an ETA for console versions of the DLC. They’re very different platforms and so the process for DLC is quite a bit different (and requires lots of time and energy), I assure you, it’s being worked on, but can’t really provide more info than that at the moment. Sorry to keep you waiting! 

[u][b]What is the Workshop? [/b][/u]

The Workshop is a magical place full of lots of wonderful extra items created by members of the community – however, it is only available to those who access the game via Steam. You can find it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/613100/workshop/]here. [/url]If you’d like to read more on how to use the workshop, you can do so [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://krej-net.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HFS/pages/1914470404/How+to+use+steam+workshop]here! [/url]

[u][b]How can I create items for the Workshop?[/b]  [/u]

Well, to create items for the workshop, you will need Unity, a steam account, the House Flipper Workshop exporter tool and something to create your 3D models! (If you’re unsure where to start, we can suggest Blender – It’s free to use). You can find a guide to creating for the workshop [url=https://krej-net.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HFS/pages/1891762220/Making+the+first+item+-+step+by+step]here.[/url]

[u][b]Where can I see patch notes? [/b][/u]

Any patch notes are posted in the game news section and added to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/613100/discussions/0/3049483938191807818/]this thread.[/url]  We recommend you follow our Steam news [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/613100/allnews/](here)[/url] to stay up to date with updates including Development Updates, sales and giveaways! 

[u][b]How can I access game screenshots on PC? [/b][/u]

So, there are two methods of taking screenshots in game!  

If you used the in-game camera/tablet function, you will find them located in the following directory provided you have House Flipper installed on your C drive:  

C:\Users\YOUR USER\AppData\LocalLow\Empyrean\House Flipper Game\Gallery 

(Change YOUR USER to your own system username). You will need to have hidden files set to display in order to view this directory.  

If you use F12, the screenshots are available when you click the game in your Steam Library and you can choose which to share/upload in the games overview in Steam.  

[u][b]Dolan Trusk keeps buying EVERYTHING! How do I get him to.. not? [/b][/u]

THAt guy, am I right?! Each buyer has requirements, thing they wish for their properties, just like any real-life house buyer. They hint at what these things are when you take actions and also during the auction process. There is this handy IGN guide to the sort of things the buyers are looking for which you may find useful ([url=https://www.ign.com/wikis/house-flipper/Buyer_Profiles]https://www.ign.com/wikis/house-flipper/Buyer_Profiles[/url]) 

[u][b]How do I earn points in the Garden Competitions? (Garden Flipper DLC content) [/b][/u]

As with the buyers, certain requirements need to be fulfilled in order to earn stars in the Garden Competitions. Certain garden types require specific items. There is a guide to these requirements here if you don’t want to figure it out for yourself (https://house-flipper.fandom.com/wiki/Garden_Competitions)  

[u][b]I’ve done all of the jobs in my inbox. Is that it? [/b][/u]

Nope! You can go to “Archive” and re-do these jobs as many times as you like. You can select “Browser” instead of “Mail” to see all of the houses available that you can purchase, renovate and sell! 

[u][b]I really liked (Insert House Name Here) and I’d love to work on that property again! Can’t I buy it again?[/b] [/u]

You can! Once you have flipped (purchased AND re-sold) each house at least once, you can buy and renovate them ‘til your heart is content!  

[u][b]House Flipper’s stance on Barry the Hamster (You'll know him once you join [url=https://discord.gg/QncyKz9V3H]our discord server[/url])? [/b][/u]

We stan. One day, he’s gonna marry Bessie and we all will be so proud. 

------------------------------------------------------------------

That's all for today, but I saved some more questions for you - does this mean there will be a second part of the FAQ? Well - I don't know! 

[i]All the best,
Frozen District Team[/i]

notes.title: Pets DLC Development Update #2 is here!
notes.content:
[h5]Hey there flippers and pet lovers![/h5]

So the development of Pets DLC is keeping up a strong pace. We’re doing our best to stay that way and to deliver all the content we have on our current to-do list. On the other hand, we also take our time to reach out to you - our lovely community, and we’re still thinking about any new possibilities to throw into the project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/5b91c1c35e8b737bfa1eab8db095e4e8ca935a45.png[/img]

In our last [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/613100/announcements/detail/3052856565572239439]Pets DLC Development Update[/url][/b] we touched upon the topic of new properties for the DLC, rabbit cage choices as well as some new furniture sets we have ready.
What can we show you this time?
This time we’re going to do something else, and show you a couple of things that are still in progress instead of showing you things that are already in the last stages of development, how about that?
In the comments below please let us know if you prefer us to show you stuff that is in its polishing phase and almost finished, or would you rather see what we’re working on at the very moment of writing this blog even if that means presenting some very in-progress and unpolished material.



First of all, our bunny is slowly starting to hop around and feels more alive than ever! The majority of our animal models are getting some of their first animations done. Take a look at a couple of examples:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/57b68edf7c4e78d1708fda61ddde5e7e24892384.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1645beee48dccb65038afd76014a07ee6a4b96c3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/4f7ff193b615d9d4c1e4212e4c54380497bf5ccb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/af83dbdd6748589fe16eda50cf17a3381464551b.gif[/img]
[i]Just check out that fancy trot! Can it get more graceful than that??[/i]



Secondly, we’re also working hard to make Pets DLC full of new exciting, fancy-looking, and fitting furniture sets as well as individual decor items. Check some of them out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/a79d96141363b80bc45e2c7509600f000a2d1833.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/ec82bfec42df5749fe12f854348508d9353dc632.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/faaa973692c90ae656388365695cda5ac98f5672.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/fc84692055a1935fca6bb1c65a69c4882a97d0ce.png[/img]
[i]Here you can see an almost final version of a new kitchen set inside the game. We still have to mess around with the colors and polish it a little bit, but it starts looking cozy![/i]



What is more? The fur!
Oh yeah flippers, good-looking fur is not that easy to implement into the game and keep it well optimized, trust me on that one! We started making some solid attempts in this field!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/0b9a5a596bdccf4e8829ab8a6765019c06355cb3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/27879c7a017b6f5beec7be76565ba7cbf890be1a.png[/img]
[i]Keep in mind that the dog models shown above are still work-in-progress while we're trying to polish their shape to give their appearance the right characteristics![/i]



And finally, last but not least, we started working on our lovely hard-shelled friends - turtles!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/90a7a37896b73fb6a8eab75f6dc5a8b90a302815.png[/img]
[i]Still a bit rough around the edges, but we're getting there![/i]



As you can see, Pets DLC is moving forward! We will see you guys in another Developer Blog that should be coming in about 2 months from now. If you’re interested in more frequent updates and news, make sure to check our [b][url=https://m.facebook.com/HFPets/]HF Pets Facebook profile[/url][/b] as well as add the DLC to your wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1569190/House_Flipper__Pets_DLC/
If you have any questions to the developers from Frozen Way who are the ones in charge of Pets DLC, you can always let us know in the comments below and we will make sure to answer them all!

[hr][/hr]

Now, if you’d like to check out another project they are working on, here’s [b]Honeycomb[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/

They recently came up with a little bit of a bigger doggo and some interesting alien flora concepts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/422f4c80ce57d278293cc5b971b3a589877813e8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/241d55dc9f0a9a5a7f1517f7f6248844615d8315.png[/img]


[i]Thank you for being here with us on our journey!
- Frozen Way Team[/i]

notes.title: Developer stream - Luxury DLC
notes.content:
[b]Hey Flippers![/b]

As you may know we're getting closer and closer to the [b]GRAND RELEASE of the Luxury DLC[/b], which is why we decided to show you guys some more [b]SPOILERS[/b] from the newest addition to our game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/533f08884e84f48be61a19929c6646aa1dc228f1.png[/img]

We're all getting extremely excited about the DLC, so it's only fair to give you guys some kind of preview of what's to come, right? We'll be talking about: 

[list]
[*] Luxury Flipper Mechanics
[*] Luxury Flipper Content
[*] The Tenants

notes.title: House Flipper adds the Kame House from Dragon Ball Z in its (real) April Fool's update
notes.content:
April Fool's Day is here, and while that means that a large part of the game industry is going to spend the day lying to you - not us, though - it also means that some devs are going to take the opportunity to make extremely silly, but real, updates to their games. Like Empyrean, for example, which has just added Dragon Ball Z's Kame House to its cult Steam hit, House Flipper.

Okay, well, it's actually the 'Make House' and there's no official mention of Dragon Ball Z here, but hey, I can't imagine the real license is cheap. Either way, this is unmistakably Master Roshi's island abode, complete with a set of seven magical balls to collect. My question: once you fix up the house, who's gonna buy real estate that you can only reach by cloud?

The update also features a number of more general additions. You can get full details in the patch notes, but the update includes new items like a "sliding door, narrow options for bathroom and living room door, pouf and sofa Tortoise, hanging corner cabinet Glen, sunglasses and two easels".

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
House Flipper is about renovation, but without all the annoying "work"

notes.title: Bring your power level to over 9000 with House Flipper!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Flippers![/b]

The April Fools Update in House Flipper takes you on a trip down memory lane - discover a tropical island, filled with glistening treasures, which might bring some of you a sense of familiarity. Collect all of the mysterious balls, said to have ties with fantastical dragons and flip a house that once belonged to a turtle-shelled master of martial arts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/1513059bc2f7931f686771f8c83532d90c62f54f.png[/img]

Here's the changelog: 

[h2]New Content:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Brand new "Turtle House"[/b] for all your training needs. 
[*] [b]New items: sliding door, narrow options for bathroom and living room door, pouf and sofa Tortoise, hanging corner cabinet Glen, sunglasses and two easels.[/b] Isn't that cool, huh?
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Stairs' sides can now be painted black.[/b] Or any other color. Or not painted at all, to get that "retro-House Flipper look". 
[*] [b]We've eliminated a space-time anomaly that caused the clocks to display wrong time.[/b] Einstein-senpai notice us. :(
[*] [b] Items may now be hung from other ceiling-like structures, e.g. window recesses.[/b] Painting ceilings is still impossible tho, please dont hate us.
[*] [b]We've added more ads to TV so it would feel more like the real thing.[/b] Commercials are still in-progress.
[*] [b]V-sync and FPS limiter are now divorced.[/b] The word is that V-sync cheated on FPS L., definitely not cool.

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Strafing stuttering should no longer be a problem.[/b] Yay us!

notes.title: Ghostmower and tons of new stuff!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there Flippers!
As promised on our latest [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HQ_zLdAb1VU]Developer Stream[/url], today we bring you a major update, and it's a big one!

On the stream we've also talked about House Flipper VR as it's already out on [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/2540541942723653/]Oculus Quest[/url] and will be out on Steam (with a graphically upgraded version) very soon:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1194700/House_Flipper_VR/

[h3]Without further ado, here's a full list of improvements and changes:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/be105e748b26484e45503eb0439db952604d418a.png[/img]


[h3]House Flipper[/h3]
[b]New content[/b]
- New items: doorbells, doors, mats, plants, ottomans, cabinets, books, bicycles, curtains, House Flipper posters, a wardrobe, a bread bin, neat fluorescent stars and a cabinet bed.
- New colors for wallpapers and blinds.
- New sizes for Persian rugs.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Removed the nuclear tiles and panels disintegrator. Now you can just put them away.
- Good news for vampire flippers. The new curtains may be drawn.
- The game was optimized for older graphics cards with memory problems.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Wall lamps factory defects have been fixed.
- The Edium shower stall was unghostified.
- The selling tool won't keep displaying the last sold item's price anymore. It will also display correct characters in Japanese.
- Asian fonts will now look better, and include previously missing characters.
- Yuan symbol was replaced with the correct one.
- Tiles and panels tooltips have been corrected.
- The pink paint has been removed from rubbish piles (macOS in openGL mode)
- The "works on my machine" factor was slightly improved.



[h3]Apocalypse DLC[/h3]
[b]New content[/b]
- A brand new assault rifle for your protection.

[b]Changes[/b]
- A new shortcut for flamethrower - the zero key.



[h3]Garden DLC[/h3]
[b]New content[/b]
- New items: topiaries, flower bed plants, concrete slabs and pools.

[b]Changes[/b]
- Welcome to the ghost realm. The lawn mower was infused with ancient ninja techniques to automatically avoid all your garden stuff when mowing.
- Patios may now be sold.
- You may now spend a cozy evening next to a lit brazier in your garden.



[h3]HGTV DLC[/h3]
[b]Fixes[/b]
- Kors shower stall can now be properly mounted.
- Order map starting position was improved. The map is now automatically opened in the same place it was closed.

notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/fa6d78066ab57710797506a38740aa0b038dd005.jpg[/img]

[b]new content:[/b]
- "That's one small step for a flipper, one giant leap for mankind"
- Numerous new items in many flavours including: electrical installation elements, desks, cabinets, tinkerer tools, indoor plants, floor coverings, lighting, chairs, clocks, hello there, books and mirrors

notes.title: Christmas Update: presentation & patch notes
notes.content:
[h3]Flippers! 😍[/h3]
[h3]While we were having some fun with our last dev stream, our developers and testers managed to get through some insane critical bugs, and fortunatelly we could deliver the Christmas Update on time![/h3]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8OCKvOzbyEg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28210044/d91d8e7422ec1eb061fc8847a52a2aaab8dfc42c.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Check out this video to see what's in there: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8OCKvOzbyEg]Christmas Update on YouTube[/url]

Also, take a look at the patch notes:[/h3]

[h3]House Flipper[/h3]
[b]New Content:[/b]
- A brand new order.
- Arms inclusiveness continued: "ho ho ho" option now available!
- New holiday-themed items.
- New not-holiday-themed items including tables, chairs, beds and many others.

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Order requirements are now displayed in the tablet.
- Shop bookmarks overhaul. New categories for indoor items and Apocalypse DLC items.
- Books can now be rotated around vertical axis.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- We've removed self-awareness of lamps. As a consequence, they won't choose their variants on their own.
- The Illuminati sigil was removed from "Man Cave".
- Item rotation will no longer reset when buying multiple items.
- Wall building is now more responsive.
- Bathtub mounting tips are back.
- Custom photos can now be added (concerns macOS).


[h3]Garden Flipper[/h3]
[b]New Content:[/b]
- 18 new plants are waiting to inhabit your garden.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- We've removed a fence painter who disliked some of the available fencing options.
- Halloween is now long gone, and so are the ghost plants.
- Grass will now grow at the same pace regardless of its surroundings.
- Plants will no longer blink, even when they're being photographed.
- The amount of cut grass is now properly measured (concerns the non OpenGL version on macOS).


[h3]🎄Enjoy the update, as well as the Christmas time!🎄

Happy Flipping[/h3]

notes.content:

[h1][i]Flippers!!
We've just rolled out with a bunch of new content and fixes for both: House and Garden Flipper!
You can see all the changes below:[/i][/h1]


[h1][b]House Flipper[/b][/h1]
[b]New Content[/b]
- A brand new house - Man Cave - available for purchase
- New items including accoustic guitar, billiard table and posters
- Two new gamepad layouts
- Two new window cleaner movement variants to choose in mouse control settings
- Two new curriences: Norwegian krone and South African rand

- Glass has been thoroughly polished, so the reflections should now look nicer
- A magnifying glass should no longer be required to read order description
- Changelog view and new game can now be launched only in the main menu
- Appraisers' negotiation skills were improved

[b]Bugs fixed and optimization[/b]
- We've performed an exorcism on "Alone Home", so the ghosts of walls should not haunt the house anymore

- Asian fonts will now appear correctly on the loading screen
