- Cockroaches won't infest your CPU anymore
- Seller tool was stripped of it's superpowers - it shouldn't cause visual lags anymore - missing windows and garage doors were restored

- The tablet's performance was improved
- Some translations were corrected
- Door will no longer refuse to interact with you (even if it's placed incorrectly)
- Apocalypse DLC light switch can now be sold


[h1][b]Garden Flipper[/b][/h1]
[b]Changes[/b]
- Tree trunk may now be removed with axe

notes.title: April Fools joke update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28210044/3beabcea02ffa31a69513cc432cb659ad726c1e7.jpg[/img]

We hope you liked the blasting experience of shooting your walls out of your way.  
A lot of you asked us to keep the shotty in the game, and while originally it wasn't something we planned to do, we can reveal a little secret...
The shotgun is going to stay in the game for some time, but only works when you change your date to [b]1st April[/b].

[b]Recent patch news (2st April)[/b]:
[b]1. New head-up display[/b]
The remaining health is now displayed more clearly.
[b]2. New skill display[/b]
The display is now 3.14 times more comfortable.
[b]3. Random stuff we felt like doing:[/b]
- certain items in the tablet store were rotated a bit to celebrate the anniversary of our original release date,
- new level up, level down, level left and level right animations,
- we've patched a bug in Apocalypse DLC which allowed some guns to be fired,
- we've removed the wall multiplication rate limiter,
- gamepad sensitivity will no longer depend on amount of pillows placed in the house.

[b]1st April:[/b]
Is it a Hammer? Is it a mop? No! It's a shotgun! A new tool of destruction in House Flipper Apocalypse DLC.

It's easy to use and you will feel like a badass! And guess what, you don't need any ammunition. If you think this is another April Fool's joke, you should run the game and try it by yourself.

notes.title: We can finally announce the date and price of the upcoming Garden Flipper DLC!
notes.content:

It's been a long way and we are finally getting to the finish line, but there are still some obstacles in front of us.
We wish to make Garden DLC an amazing addition to our game, and we need a bit more time that it's been originally stated.

[h1]At the moment the game is in a polishing stage, and we are getting ready to send out the first copies to our group of testers.
The testing and bug fixing stage is going to take time as we really want to put in our best effort to deliver you a flawless piece of content.[/h1]

    - sculptures

    - swings

notes.title: Release Date Change (Update)
notes.content:
[b]Hey House Flippers![/b]

    The last week for us was filled with intensive work on House Flipper. We hired a squadron of professional testers and we received from you lot of suggestions about the game. Your voice in the production of House Flipper was very important to us, and this time we also want to heed your voice! 

    We are just a step away from the release and we want to be sure that the game will bring you lots of fun, regardless of whether you play on a PC or Mac, in English, Ukrainian or Korean. We could release the game tomorrow, but this would be a waste of your feedback and the support that you have given us. We need to ask you to be a little more patient, while ensuring you that the deadline for releasing the game on Steam is [b][i]May 17, 2018 at 15:00 UTC[/i][/b]. 

[b]House Flipper Team[/b]

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b][h1]Update[/h1][/b]
We were considering early access, but there are many reasons not to do that.
[olist]
[*]We'd need to come out of Early Access on 2017-05-17 anyway, because then we are publishing full version of the game.
This date is final and we have signed contracts for box version in retail stores in many countries.

[*]It would be bad for a game - now we can fix and improve things quickly, not supporting thousands of players, and not having to handle backwards compability (i.e. saves). After release it will be different.

[*]Releasing on Early Access is a process that has requirements and takes time! 
You need to request it, prepare information about the current state of game, go through whole acceptance process on Steam, update website according to Steam requirements, etc. 
It could easily take more than a month anyway.
[/olist]

[b]Important note:[/b]

    Although we do not publish the game as an Early Access title, we will improve the game for many months after the release. We plan to add new houses, appraisers, mechanics and items. We hope that you'll support us in doing so.
